title.zh: 卷一百二十七 列傳第十四: 伯顏
title.raw: 卷一百二十七 列傳第十四: 伯顏 Volume 127 Biographies 14: Bayan

sentences.zh: 列傳第十四

translations.literal: Biographies, Number Fourteen
translations.idiomatic: Biography 14

sentences.zh: ○伯顏

translations.literal: ○ Bayan
translations.idiomatic: ○ Bayan

sentences.zh: 伯顏，蒙古八鄰部人。

translations.literal: Bayan was a man of the Mongol Bayin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was from the Mongol Bayin tribe.

sentences.zh: 曾祖述律哥圖，事太祖，為八鄰部左千戶。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Shulügetu served the Taizu [Genghis Khan] and was Left Commander of a Thousand of the Bayin tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Shulügetu had served Genghis Khan as Left Commander of a Thousand of the Bayin tribe.

sentences.zh: 祖阿剌，襲父職，兼斷事官，平忽禪有功，得食其地。

translations.literal: His grandfather Ala inherited his father's post, also served as judge, pacified Huchan with merit, and received the revenues of that land.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Ala succeeded to his father's office, also served as a judge, distinguished himself in pacifying Huchan, and was granted the revenues of that territory.

sentences.zh: 父曉古台世其官，從宗王旭烈兀開西域。

translations.literal: His father Xiaogutai inherited the office in turn and followed the prince Hulagu in opening the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xiaogutai inherited the family post and followed Prince Hulagu in the conquest of the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 伯顏長於西域。

translations.literal: Bayan grew up in the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was raised in the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 至元初，旭烈兀遣入奏事，世祖見其貌偉，聽其言厲，曰：「非諸侯王臣也，其留事朕。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhiyuan era, Hulagu sent him in to report affairs; the Shizu Emperor [Kublai] saw his imposing appearance and heard his stern speech, and said: "He is no mere vassal prince's subject—let him remain to serve Us."
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhiyuan reign, Hulagu sent him to court to report on affairs. Kublai saw his imposing stature and heard his forceful speech and said, "This is no mere subject of a feudal prince—let him stay and serve me."

sentences.zh: 與謀國事，恆出廷臣右，世祖益賢之，敕以中書右丞相安童女弟妻之，若曰「為伯顏婦，不慚爾氏矣」。

translations.literal: In deliberating on state affairs he constantly stood above the court ministers; the Shizu Emperor prized him all the more, ordered that the younger sister of the Right Chancellor of the Secretariat Antong be given to him in marriage, as if to say, "To be Bayan's wife does not shame your clan."
translations.idiomatic: In council on state affairs he consistently outshone the court ministers. The emperor valued him still more and commanded that Antong's younger sister, the Right Chancellor of the Secretariat, be given to him in marriage, saying in effect, "To be Bayan's wife is no disgrace to your house."

sentences.zh: 二年七月，拜光祿大夫、中書左丞相。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Left Chancellor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year two he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Left Chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 諸曹白事，有難決者，徐以一二語決之。

translations.literal: When the various offices reported matters and there were difficult decisions, he would slowly decide them with a phrase or two.
translations.idiomatic: When the various bureaus brought reports with knotty points, he would settle them unhurriedly in a sentence or two.

sentences.zh: 眾服曰：「真宰輔也。」

translations.literal: The multitude submitted and said: "A true chief minister."
translations.idiomatic: Everyone conceded, "A true chief minister."

sentences.zh: 四年，改中書右丞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was changed to Right Vice-Chancellor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In year four he was transferred to Right Vice-Chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year seven he became Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十年春，持節奉玉冊立燕王真金為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year, bearing credentials he presented the jade book and installed Prince Zhenjin of Yan as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the tenth year he bore imperial credentials, presented the jade investiture book, and installed Prince Zhenjin of Yan as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 十一年，大舉伐宋，與史天澤並拜中書左丞相，行省荊湖。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, with a great campaign against Song, he and Shi Tianze were jointly appointed Left Chancellor of the Secretariat and provincial commissioner of Jing-Hu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, when a major campaign against the Song was launched, he and Shi Tianze were jointly appointed Left Chancellor of the Secretariat with authority over the Jing-Hu circuit.

sentences.zh: 時荊湖、淮西各建行省，天澤言，號令不一，或致敗事。

translations.literal: At that time Jing-Hu and Huai-Xi each had a separate provincial commission; Tianze said that with commands not unified, defeat might result.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jing-Hu and Huai-Xi each had its own provincial commission. Tianze argued that divided commands could bring defeat.

sentences.zh: 詔改淮西行省為行樞密院。

translations.literal: An edict changed the Huai-Xi provincial commission into a mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict converted the Huai-Xi provincial commission into a mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 天澤又以病，表請專任伯顏，乃以伯顏領河南等路行中書省，所屬並聽節制。

translations.literal: Tianze again, being ill, memorialized asking that Bayan alone be entrusted; Bayan was then put in charge of the Henan circuit mobile Secretariat, and all subordinates were to obey his command.
translations.idiomatic: Tianze, again ill, memorialized that Bayan alone should hold command. Bayan was then placed over the mobile Secretariat of the Henan circuit, and all subordinates were placed under his orders.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，陛辭，世祖諭之曰：「昔曹彬以不嗜殺平江南，汝其體朕心，為吾曹彬可也。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on taking leave at court, the Shizu Emperor instructed him: "In former times Cao Bin pacified the south of the Yangtze without loving slaughter—you should embody Our mind and be Our Cao Bin."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, when he took leave at court, Kublai told him, "Long ago Cao Bin pacified the south without a taste for slaughter. Take my intent to heart and be my Cao Bin."

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌朔，會師於襄陽，分軍為三道並進。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, jiaxu, the armies assembled at Xiangyang and were divided into three columns to advance together.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month (jiaxu) the armies assembled at Xiangyang and advanced in three columns.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，伯顏與平章阿術由中道循漢江趨郢州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Bayan and the Grand Councillor Aju took the center route along the Han River toward Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Bayan and Grand Councillor Aju took the central route along the Han toward Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 萬戶武秀為前鋒，遇水濼，霖雨水溢，無舟不能涉。

translations.literal: The commander of ten thousand Wu Xiu was vanguard; they met flooded marshland, rain had swollen the waters, and without boats they could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of Ten Thousand Wu Xiu led the vanguard. They met flooded marshland—the rains had swollen the waters—and without boats they could not cross.

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰：「吾且飛渡大江，而憚此潢潦耶！」

translations.literal: Bayan said: "I am about to fly across the Great River—shall I fear this stagnant flood!"
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said, "I mean to fly across the Great River—shall I shrink from this standing flood?"

sentences.zh: 乃召一壯士，負甲仗，騎而前導，麾諸軍畢濟。

translations.literal: He then summoned a strong man, who bore armor and weapons and rode ahead as guide, and commanded the whole army to cross.
translations.idiomatic: He called forward a strong man bearing armor and weapons to ride ahead as guide and ordered the whole army across.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，次鹽山，距郢州二十里。

translations.literal: On guisi they halted at Yanshan, twenty li from Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi they encamped at Yanshan, twenty li from Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 郢在漢水北，以石為城，宋人又于漢水南築新郢，橫鐵繩，鎖戰艦，密樹樁木水中。

translations.literal: Ying lay north of the Han, with a stone wall; the Song also built New Ying south of the Han, stretched iron chains, locked warships, and densely planted piles in the water.
translations.idiomatic: Ying lay north of the Han behind stone walls. The Song had also built New Ying south of the river, stretched iron chains to lock warships, and planted dense stakes in the water.

sentences.zh: 下流黃家灣堡，亦設守禦之具，堡之西有溝，南通藤湖，至江僅數里。

translations.literal: Downstream at Huangjiawan Fort they also set defenses; west of the fort was a ditch running south to Teng Lake, only several li to the river.
translations.idiomatic: Downstream at Huangjiawan Fort they had defenses as well. West of the fort a ditch ran south to Teng Lake, only a few li from the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 乃遣總管李庭、劉國傑攻黃家灣堡，拔之，破竹席地，蕩舟由藤湖入漢江。

translations.literal: He then sent supervisors Li Ting and Liu Guojie to attack Huangjiawan Fort, took it, cut bamboo mats for ground cover, and poled boats through Teng Lake into the Han.
translations.idiomatic: He sent supervisors Li Ting and Liu Guojie to storm Huangjiawan Fort, took it, laid bamboo matting, and poled boats through Teng Lake into the Han.

sentences.zh: 諸將請曰：「郢城，我之喉襟，不取，恐為後患。」

translations.literal: The generals requested: "Ying city is our throat—if we do not take it, we fear later trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The generals urged, "Ying is our throat—if we do not take it we may regret it later."

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰：「用兵緩急，我則知之。

translations.literal: Bayan said: "The urgency of using troops—I know it.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan replied, "I know when to press and when to wait.

sentences.zh: 攻城，下策也，大軍之出，豈為此一城哉！」

translations.literal: Besieging cities is the inferior stratagem; did the great army march out for this one town!"
translations.idiomatic: Besieging cities is the lesser stratagem. Did this great army march out for a single town?"

sentences.zh: 遂舍郢，順流下。

translations.literal: He then abandoned Ying and went downstream.
translations.idiomatic: He left Ying and continued downstream.

sentences.zh: 伯顏、阿術殿后，不滿百騎。

translations.literal: Bayan and Aju brought up the rear with fewer than a hundred horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan and Aju brought up the rear with fewer than a hundred horsemen.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，行大澤中，郢將趙文義、範興以騎二千來襲，伯顏、阿術未及介胄，亟還軍迎擊之。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the tenth month, marching through a great marsh, Ying generals Zhao Wenyi and Fan Xing came with two thousand horsemen to attack; Bayan and Aju had not yet donned armor and hurried back to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's wuwu day, marching through a great marsh, Ying generals Zhao Wenyi and Fan Xing struck with two thousand horsemen. Bayan and Aju had not yet donned armor and wheeled back to fight.

sentences.zh: 伯顏手殺文義，擒範興殺之，其士卒死者五百人，生獲數十人。

translations.literal: Bayan personally killed Wenyi, captured Xing and killed him; of their soldiers five hundred died and several tens were taken alive.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan himself killed Wenyi, seized Xing and executed him; five hundred of their men died and several dozen were captured.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次沙洋。

translations.literal: On jiazi they halted at Shayang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi they reached Shayang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命斷事官楊仁風招之，不應。

translations.literal: On yichou he ordered the judge Yang Renfeng to summon them—they did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he ordered Judge Yang Renfeng to summon the city—they did not answer.

sentences.zh: 復使一俘持黃榜、檄文，傳趙文義首，入城，招其守將王虎臣、王大用。

translations.literal: Again he sent a captive bearing a yellow placard and proclamation, carrying Zhao Wenyi's head, into the city to summon the defenders Wang Huchen and Wang Dayong.
translations.idiomatic: He sent another captive with a yellow placard and proclamation, displaying Zhao Wenyi's head, to summon defenders Wang Huchen and Wang Dayong.

sentences.zh: 虎臣等斬俘，焚黃榜。

translations.literal: Huchen and the others executed the captive and burned the yellow placard.
translations.idiomatic: Huchen and the others killed the messenger and burned the placard.

sentences.zh: 裨將傅益以水軍十七人來降，虎臣等又斬其軍之欲降者。

translations.literal: The deputy general Fu Yi came with seventeen men of the navy to surrender; Huchen again killed those in his army who wished to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Fu Yi came with seventeen naval men to surrender; Huchen again executed men in the garrison who wished to yield.

sentences.zh: 伯顏復命呂文煥招之，又不應。

translations.literal: Bayan again ordered Lü Wenhuan to summon them—they again did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan again ordered Lü Wenhuan to summon them—they still refused.

sentences.zh: 日暮，風大起，伯顏命順風掣金汁砲，焚其廬舍，煙焰漲天，城遂破。

translations.literal: At dusk the wind rose greatly; Bayan ordered molten-metal cannon fired with the wind, burning their huts; smoke and flame filled the sky and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk a great wind rose. Bayan ordered molten-metal cannon fired downwind, burning the huts until smoke and flame filled the sky, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 萬戶忙古歹生擒虎臣、大用等四人，余悉屠之。

translations.literal: The commander of ten thousand Mangudai captured alive Huchen, Dayong, and four others; the rest were all slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of Ten Thousand Mangudai took Huchen, Dayong, and four others alive; the rest were put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次新城，令萬戶帖木兒、史弼列沙洋所馘於城下，射黃榜、檄文於城中以招之。

translations.literal: On bingyin they reached Xincheng and ordered the commanders of ten thousand Temür and Shi Bi to display the heads taken at Shayang below the wall and shoot yellow placards and proclamations into the city to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin they reached Xincheng and ordered commanders Temür and Shi Bi to display Shayang's severed heads below the wall and shoot in placards and proclamations.

sentences.zh: 其守將邊居誼，邀呂文煥與語。

translations.literal: Its defender Bian Juyi invited Lü Wenhuan to speak.
translations.idiomatic: The defender Bian Juyi invited Lü Wenhuan to parley.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，文煥至城下，飛矢中右臂，奔還。

translations.literal: On dingmao Wenhuan came below the wall; a flying arrow struck his right arm and he fled back.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wenhuan came to the wall; a stray arrow struck his right arm and he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，其總制黃順逾城出降，即授招討使，佩以金符，令呼城上軍，其部曲即縋城下，居誼邀入城，悉斬之。

translations.literal: On wuchen their overall commander Huang Shun climbed over the wall to surrender; he was immediately made Pacification Commissioner and given a gold tally, ordered to call down the troops on the wall; his men were let down by rope, Juyi invited them into the city, and all were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen their overall commander Huang Shun climbed out to surrender. Bayan made him Pacification Commissioner, gave him a gold tally, and ordered him to call the garrison down; as his men were lowered on ropes Juyi pulled them in and beheaded them all.

sentences.zh: 己巳，其副都統制任寧亦降，居誼終不出，乃令總管李庭攻破其外堡，諸軍蟻附而登，拔之。

translations.literal: On jisi their vice overall commander Ren Ning also surrendered; Juyi still would not come out, so he ordered Supervisor Li Ting to storm the outer fort; the armies swarmed up like ants and took it.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Vice Overall Commander Ren Ning also surrendered. Juyi still would not yield, so Li Ting was ordered to break the outer fort; troops swarmed up and took it.

sentences.zh: 餘眾三千，猶力戰而死，居誼舉家自焚。

translations.literal: The remaining three thousand still fought to the death; Juyi burned his whole household.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand defenders still fought to the death; Juyi burned his entire household.

sentences.zh: 遂並誅王虎臣、王大用等四人。

translations.literal: Wang Huchen, Wang Dayong, and four others were then all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huchen, Wang Dayong, and four others were then executed together.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，次復州，知州翟貴以城降。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the eleventh month they reached Fuzhou; the prefect Zhai Gui surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's bingxu day they reached Fuzhou; Prefect Zhai Gui surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 諸將請點視其倉庫軍籍，遣官鎮撫，伯顏不聽，諭諸將不得入城，違者以軍法論。

translations.literal: The generals requested to inspect warehouses and military registers and send officials to pacify; Bayan would not listen and instructed the generals not to enter the city—violators would be punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: Generals asked to inventory warehouses and registers and post pacification officials. Bayan refused and ordered that no one enter the city on pain of military law.

sentences.zh: 阿術使右丞阿裏海牙來言渡江之期，伯顏不答。

translations.literal: Aju sent the Right Chancellor Arighaiya to speak of the date for crossing the river; Bayan did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Aju sent Right Chancellor Arighaiya to ask when they would cross the river; Bayan gave no answer.

sentences.zh: 明日又來，又不答。

translations.literal: The next day he came again—again no answer.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he came again—still no answer.

sentences.zh: 阿術乃自來，伯顏曰：「此大事也，主上以付吾二人，可使餘人知吾實乎？」

translations.literal: Aju then came himself; Bayan said: "This is a great affair—the sovereign entrusted it to us two; can we let others know our true plan?"
translations.idiomatic: Aju came in person. Bayan said, "This is a grave matter the sovereign entrusted to us two alone—shall we let others know our plan?"

sentences.zh: 潛刻期而去。

translations.literal: He secretly fixed the date and left.
translations.idiomatic: He fixed the date in secret and departed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，軍次蔡店。

translations.literal: On yiwei the army halted at Caidian.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the army encamped at Caidian.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，往觀漢口形勢。

translations.literal: On dingyou he went to observe the situation at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to reconnoiter Hankou.

sentences.zh: 宋淮西制置使夏貴等，以戰艦萬艘，分據要害，都統王達守陽邏堡，京湖宣撫硃礻異孫以遊擊軍扼中流，兵不得進。

translations.literal: The Song Huai-Xi commissioner Xia Gui and others, with ten thousand warships, held key points; the overall commander Wang Da guarded Yangluo Fort; the Jing-Hu commissioner Zhu Qiansun with raiding troops blocked midstream, and the army could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Song Huai-Xi Commissioner Xia Gui and others held key points with ten thousand warships. Overall Commander Wang Da held Yangluo Fort; Jing-Hu Commissioner Zhu Qiansun with raiders blocked midstream, and the army could not advance.

sentences.zh: 千戶馬福建言，淪河口可通沙蕪入江，伯顏使覘沙蕪口，夏貴亦以精兵守之。

translations.literal: The commander of a thousand Ma Fujian said the Lun River mouth could reach Shaxu and enter the Yangtze; Bayan sent scouts to Shaxu, and Xia Gui also guarded it with elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of a Thousand Ma Fujian said the Lun River mouth led through Shaxu into the Yangtze. Bayan sent scouts; Xia Gui also held Shaxu with elite troops.

sentences.zh: 乃圍漢陽軍，聲言由漢口渡江，貴果移兵援漢陽。

translations.literal: He then besieged Hanyang Prefecture, declaring he would cross at Hankou; Gui indeed moved troops to aid Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Hanyang, proclaiming he would cross at Hankou; Gui duly shifted troops to relieve Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，軍次漢口。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingwu the army halted at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, the army halted at Hankou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，諸將自漢口開壩，引船入淪河，先遣萬戶阿剌罕以兵拒沙蕪口，逼近武磯，巡視陽羅城堡，徑趨沙蕪，遂入大江。

translations.literal: On xinhai the generals opened the dam at Hankou and led boats into the Lun River; first they sent the commander of ten thousand Alahan with troops to hold Shaxu, approach Wuji, reconnoiter Yangluo Fort, and go straight to Shaxu, then enter the Great River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the generals breached the Hankou dam and led boats into the Lun River, first sending Commander Alahan to hold Shaxu, press Wuji, scout Yangluo Fort, strike Shaxu, and enter the Great River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，伯顏戰艦萬計，相踵而至，以數千艘泊於淪河灣口，屯布蒙古、漢軍數十萬騎於江北。

translations.literal: On renzi Bayan's war fleet numbered in the tens of thousands, arriving one after another; several thousand ships moored at the Lun River bay mouth, and several hundred thousand Mongol and Han cavalry were stationed north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Bayan's war fleet of tens of thousands arrived in succession; thousands of ships lay at the Lun River mouth and hundreds of thousands of Mongol and Han cavalry camped north of the river.

sentences.zh: 諸將言：「沙蕪南岸，彼戰船在焉，可攻而取。」

translations.literal: The generals said: "On the south bank of Shaxu their warships are there and can be attacked and taken."
translations.idiomatic: Generals said, "Their warships lie on Shaxu's south bank—we can take them."

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰：「吾亦知其可必取，慮汝輩貪小功，失大事；

translations.literal: Bayan said: "I too know they can surely be taken, but I fear you will covet small merit and lose the great affair;
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said, "I know they can be taken, but I fear you will chase small gains and lose the great prize;

sentences.zh: 一舉渡江，收其全功可也。」

translations.literal: one crossing of the river to reap the full merit will do."
translations.idiomatic: one crossing of the river to win the whole prize is enough."

sentences.zh: 遂令修攻具，進軍陽羅堡。

translations.literal: He then ordered siege equipment prepared and advanced on Yangluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered siege gear prepared and advanced on Yangluo Fort.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣人招之，不應。

translations.literal: On guichou he sent men to summon them—they did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he sent envoys to summon them—they refused.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，再遣人招之，其將士皆曰：「我輩受宋厚恩，戮力死戰，此其時也，安有叛逆歸降之理。

translations.literal: On jiayin he again sent men to summon them; their officers and soldiers all said: "We have received thick favor from Song and will fight to the death—this is the time; how could there be reason to rebel and surrender?
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he summoned them again. Their officers and men said, "Song has favored us deeply—we fight to the death now. How could we rebel and surrender?

sentences.zh: 備吾甲兵，決之今日，我宋天下，猶賭博孤注，輸贏在此一擲爾。」

translations.literal: Prepare our armor and weapons—let it be decided today; our Song realm is like gambling all on one throw; win or lose is in this one cast."
translations.idiomatic: Arm yourselves—we settle it today. Our Song is like a gambler's last throw; victory or ruin hangs on this one cast."

sentences.zh: 伯顏麾諸將攻之，三日不克。

translations.literal: Bayan commanded the generals to attack; three days they could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan ordered the assault; three days passed without success.

sentences.zh: 有術者來言：「天道南行，金、木相犯，若二星交過，則江可渡。」

translations.literal: A diviner came saying: "The Way of Heaven moves south; metal and wood offend each other—if the two stars cross, the river can be crossed."
translations.idiomatic: A diviner said, "Heaven's course runs south; metal and wood clash—when two stars cross, the river may be crossed."

sentences.zh: 伯顏卻之，使勿言。

translations.literal: Bayan sent him away and ordered him not to speak.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan dismissed him and forbade further talk.

sentences.zh: 乃密謀于阿術曰：「彼謂我必拔此堡，方能渡江。

translations.literal: He then secretly plotted with Aju: "They think we must take this fort before we can cross the river.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly told Aju, "They think we must take this fort before we can cross.

sentences.zh: 此堡甚堅，攻之徒勞。

translations.literal: This fort is very strong; attacking is wasted labor.
translations.idiomatic: The fort is too strong—storming it is wasted effort.

sentences.zh: 汝今夜以鐵騎三千，泛舟直趨上流，為搗虛之計，詰旦渡江襲南岸。

translations.literal: Tonight you take three thousand iron cavalry, float boats straight upriver as a feint, and at dawn cross the river and strike the south bank.
translations.idiomatic: Tonight take three thousand iron cavalry, float boats upriver as a diversion, and at dawn cross and strike the south bank.

sentences.zh: 已過，則速遣人報我。」

translations.literal: Once across, quickly send men to report to me."
translations.idiomatic: Once across, send word to me at once."

sentences.zh: 乙卯，分遣右丞阿裏海牙督萬戶張弘範、忽失海牙、折的迷失等，先以步騎攻陽羅堡，夏貴來援。

translations.literal: On yimao he separately sent the Right Chancellor Arighaiya to supervise the commanders of ten thousand Zhang Hongfan, Qoshai, and Chedan Shimi, first with infantry and cavalry to attack Yangluo Fort; Xia Gui came to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he sent Right Chancellor Arighaiya to lead commanders Zhang Hongfan, Qoshai, and Chedan Shimi to attack Yangluo with foot and horse while Xia Gui came to relieve it.

sentences.zh: 遂俾阿術出其不意，率萬戶晏徹兒、忙古歹、史格、賈文備四翼軍，溯流西上四十里，對青山磯而泊。

translations.literal: He then had Aju take them unawares, leading the four wing armies of the commanders of ten thousand Yanchir, Mangudai, Shi Ge, and Jia Wenbei, going upriver forty li west and mooring opposite Qingshanji.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Aju by surprise with the four wing armies of Yanchir, Mangudai, Shi Ge, and Jia Wenbei forty li upriver to moor opposite Qingshanji.

sentences.zh: 是夜，雪大作，遙見南岸多露沙洲，阿術登舟，指示諸將，令徑趨是洲，載馬後隨。

translations.literal: That night snow fell heavily; from afar many sandbars were seen exposed on the south bank; Aju boarded a boat, pointed them out to the generals, and ordered them to make straight for those bars, with horses loaded to follow.
translations.idiomatic: That night heavy snow fell. Sandbars showed on the south bank; Aju boarded, pointed them out, and ordered a dash for those bars with horses loaded to follow.

sentences.zh: 萬戶史格一軍先渡，為其都統程鵬飛所卻。

translations.literal: The army of the commander of ten thousand Shi Ge crossed first and was repulsed by their overall commander Cheng Pengfei.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Ge's wing crossed first and was driven back by Overall Commander Cheng Pengfei.

sentences.zh: 阿術橫身蕩決，血戰中流，擒其將高邦顯等，死者無算，鵬飛被七創，敗走，得船千餘艘，遂得南岸。

translations.literal: Aju threw himself into the current and fought bloodily midstream, capturing their generals Gao Bangxian and others; the dead were beyond counting; Pengfei took seven wounds, fled in defeat, and more than a thousand boats were taken—the south bank was secured.
translations.idiomatic: Aju plunged into the current and fought midstream, capturing Gao Bangxian and others. Countless died; Pengfei took seven wounds and fled. More than a thousand boats were seized and the south bank secured.

sentences.zh: 阿術與鎮撫何瑋等數十人，攀岸步鬥，開而復合者數四。

translations.literal: Aju and the pacification commissioner He Wei and several tens of men climbed the bank and fought on foot, parting and rejoining four times.
translations.idiomatic: Aju, Pacification Commissioner He Wei, and dozens climbed the bank and fought on foot, parting and rejoining four times.

sentences.zh: 南軍阻水，不得相薄，遂起浮橋，成列而渡。

translations.literal: The southern army was blocked by water and could not close; they then built a floating bridge and crossed in formation.
translations.idiomatic: Southern troops could not close because of the water; they built a floating bridge and crossed in ranks.

sentences.zh: 阿裏海牙繼遣張榮實、解汝楫等四翼軍，舳艫相銜，直抵夏貴。

translations.literal: Arighaiya then sent the four wing armies of Zhang Rongshi, Xie Ruji, and others; ships linked stem to stern and went straight to Xia Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Arighaiya sent the four wings of Zhang Rongshi, Xie Ruji, and others; ships locked stem to stern and drove at Xia Gui.

sentences.zh: 貴引麾下軍數千先遁，諸軍乘之，斬溺不可數計，追至鄂州東門而還。

translations.literal: Gui led several thousand of his personal troops to flee first; the armies pressed them; those cut down and drowned were beyond counting; pursuit reached the east gate of Ezhou and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Gui fled first with several thousand of his household troops. The armies pressed the rout—slain and drowned beyond counting—pursuing to Ezhou's east gate before turning back.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，阿術遣使來報，伯顏大喜，揮諸將急攻破陽羅堡，斬王達。

translations.literal: On bingchen Aju sent a messenger to report; Bayan was greatly pleased and waved the generals to storm Yangluo Fort quickly, beheading Wang Da.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Aju's messenger arrived. Bayan rejoiced and ordered the generals to storm Yangluo at once; Wang Da was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 宋軍大潰，數十萬眾死傷幾盡。

translations.literal: The Song army collapsed in great rout; of several hundred thousand men dead and wounded nearly all perished.
translations.idiomatic: The Song army collapsed; of several hundred thousand men nearly all were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 夏貴僅以身免，走至白虎山。

translations.literal: Xia Gui barely escaped with his body and fled to Baihu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Gui barely escaped alive and fled to Baihu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 諸將謂貴大將，不可使逸去，請追之。

translations.literal: The generals said Gui was a great commander and must not be allowed to escape, and requested pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Generals said Gui was a great commander and must not escape, and asked to pursue.

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰；

translations.literal: Bayan said;
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said:

sentences.zh: 「陽羅之捷，吾欲遣使前告宋人，而貴走代吾使，不必追也。」

translations.literal: "With the victory at Yangluo I wished to send envoys ahead to tell the Song, and Gui has fled in my envoys' place—there is no need to pursue."
translations.idiomatic: "At Yangluo I meant to send envoys to the Song; Gui has fled in their place—no need to pursue."

sentences.zh: 丁巳，伯顏登武磯山，大江南北，皆我軍也，諸將稱賀，伯顏辭謝之。

translations.literal: On dingsi Bayan ascended Wuji Mountain; north and south of the Great River were all our armies; the generals congratulated him and Bayan declined thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Bayan climbed Wuji Mountain. North and south of the Great River were all our troops. Generals congratulated him; Bayan declined the praise.

sentences.zh: 阿術還渡江，議兵所向，或欲先取蘄、黃，阿術曰：「若赴下流，退無所據，先取鄂、漢，雖遲旬日，可為萬全計。」

translations.literal: Aju recrossed the river; they debated where the army should go; some wished first to take Qi and Huang; Aju said: "If we go downstream there is nowhere to fall back—first take E and Han; though a fortnight late, it is the plan of perfect safety."
translations.idiomatic: Aju recrossed to debate the next move. Some wanted Qi and Huang first. Aju said, "Downstream we have no fallback—take E and Han first. A fortnight's delay buys safety."

sentences.zh: 伯顏從之。

translations.literal: Bayan followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan agreed.

sentences.zh: 己未，師次鄂州，遣呂文煥、楊仁風等諭之曰：「汝國所恃者，江、淮而已，今我大兵飛渡長江，如履平地，汝輩何不速降。」

translations.literal: On jiwei the army halted at Ezhou and sent Lü Wenhuan, Yang Renfeng, and others to instruct them: "What your state relies on is only the rivers and Huai—now our great army has flown across the Long River as if on level ground; why do you not quickly surrender?"
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the army reached Ezhou. Lü Wenhuan and Yang Renfeng were sent to say, "Your state relied on the rivers and Huai alone. Our host has flown across the Yangtze as on dry land—why not surrender at once?"

sentences.zh: 鄂恃漢陽，將戰，乃焚其戰艦三千艘，火照城中，兩城大恐。

translations.literal: E relied on Hanyang and was about to fight; they burned three thousand warships; fire lit the city and both cities were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Ezhou relied on Hanyang and prepared to fight, then burned three thousand warships. Fire lit both cities and terror spread.

sentences.zh: 庚申，知鄂州張晏然、知漢陽軍王儀、知德安府來興國，皆以城降，程鵬飛以其軍降。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Ezhou prefect Zhang Yanran, the Hanyang military commissioner Wang Yi, and the De'an prefect Lai Xingguo all surrendered their cities; Cheng Pengfei surrendered with his army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Ezhou Prefect Zhang Yanran, Hanyang Commissioner Wang Yi, and De'an Prefect Lai Xingguo surrendered their cities; Cheng Pengfei surrendered with his army.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，定新附官品級，撤宋兵，分隸諸將。

translations.literal: On renxu the grades of offices for the newly submitted were fixed and Song troops were disbanded and assigned to the various commanders.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu they fixed ranks for newly submitted officials, disbanded Song troops, and assigned them to the various commanders.

sentences.zh: 先是，邊民戍卒陷入宋境者，悉縱遣之。

translations.literal: Earlier, border people and garrison soldiers who had fallen into Song territory were all released and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, border people and garrison soldiers trapped in Song territory had all been released and sent home.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣萬戶也的哥、總管忽都歹，入奏渡江之捷。

translations.literal: On dingmao he sent the commander of ten thousand Yedege and the supervisor Qudu to enter court and report the victory of crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he sent Commander Yedege and Supervisor Qudu to court to report the river crossing victory.

sentences.zh: 分命阿剌罕先鋒黃頭取壽昌糧四十萬斛，以充軍餉。

translations.literal: He separately ordered the vanguard Alahan to take Shouchang grain, four hundred thousand hu, to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered vanguard Alahan to seize four hundred thousand hu of grain at Shouchang for the army.

sentences.zh: 留右丞阿裏海牙等，以兵四萬分省于鄂，規取荊湖。

translations.literal: He left the Right Chancellor Arighaiya and others with forty thousand troops quartered at E to plan the taking of Jing-Hu.
translations.idiomatic: He left Right Chancellor Arighaiya with forty thousand men at Ezhou to plan the conquest of Jing-Hu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，伯顏與阿術以大軍水陸東下，俾阿術先據黃州。

translations.literal: On jisi Bayan and Aju with the great army went east by land and water, having Aju first seize Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Bayan and Aju marched the main force east by land and water, sending Aju first to take Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月癸酉朔，至黃州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, on the first day guiyou, they reached Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year's first month, on guiyou, they reached Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，沿江制置副使、知黃州陳奕降，伯顏承制授奕沿江大都督。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the vice commissioner along the river and Huangzhou prefect Chen Yi surrendered; Bayan by imperial order made Yi Grand Commander along the River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Vice Commissioner along the River and Huangzhou Prefect Chen Yi surrendered; Bayan appointed him Grand Commander along the River by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 奕遣書至漣水招其子岩，岩降。

translations.literal: Yi sent a letter to Lianshui to summon his son Yan, and Yan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yi sent word to Lianshui summoning his son Yan, who surrendered.

sentences.zh: 遣呂文煥、陳奕以書招蘄州安撫使管宗模，復遣阿術以舟師造其城下。

translations.literal: He sent Lü Wenhuan and Chen Yi with letters to summon the Qizhou commissioner Guan Zongmo, and again sent Aju with the fleet to its walls.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Lü Wenhuan and Chen Yi with letters to summon Qizhou Commissioner Guan Zongmo, and again sent Aju's fleet to the walls.

sentences.zh: 癸未，伯顏至蘄州，宗模出降，即承制授以淮西宣撫使，留萬戶帶塔兒守之。

translations.literal: On guiwei Bayan reached Qizhou; Zongmo came out to surrender and was immediately made Huai-Xi Commissioner by imperial order; the commander of ten thousand Daita'er was left to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Bayan reached Qizhou; Zongmo surrendered and was made Huai-Xi Commissioner; Commander Daita'er was left to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 阿術復以舟師先趨江州，兵部尚書呂師夔在江州，與知州錢真孫遣人來迎降。

translations.literal: Aju again with the fleet hurried first to Jiangzhou; the Minister of War Lü Shiqian was at Jiangzhou and with the prefect Qian Zhensun sent men to welcome and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Aju again pressed ahead by water to Jiangzhou. Minister of War Lü Shiqian and Prefect Qian Zhensun sent men to welcome the surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，伯顏至江州，即以師夔為江州守。

translations.literal: On bingxu Bayan reached Jiangzhou and immediately made Shiqian defender of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Bayan reached Jiangzhou and made Shiqian defender of the city.

sentences.zh: 師夔設宴庾公樓，選宋宗室女二人，盛飾以獻，伯顏怒曰：「吾奉聖天子明命，興仁義之師，問罪于宋，豈以女色移吾志乎！

translations.literal: Shiqian set a feast at the Genggong Tower, selected two daughters of the Song imperial clan, richly adorned them to present; Bayan angrily said: "I bear the bright Son of Heaven's clear command, raising an army of benevolence and righteousness to call Song to account—shall woman's beauty shift my will!
translations.idiomatic: Shiqian feasted him at Genggong Tower and offered two richly adorned Song imperial clanswomen. Bayan said angrily, "I march under the Son of Heaven's clear mandate with an army of benevolence and righteousness to call Song to account—shall women's beauty sway my will?

sentences.zh: 「斥遣之。

translations.literal: " He sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: He sent them away.

sentences.zh: 知南康軍葉閶來降，殿前都指揮使、知安慶府範文虎亦奉書納款，阿術遂率舟師造安慶，文虎出降。

translations.literal: The Nankang military commissioner Ye Chang came to surrender; the Palace Commander and Anqing prefect Fan Wenhu also sent a letter offering allegiance; Aju then led the fleet to Anqing and Wenhu came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang Commissioner Ye Chang surrendered; Palace Commander and Anqing Prefect Fan Wenhu sent allegiance; Aju led the fleet to Anqing and Wenhu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 伯顏至湖口，遣千戶寧玉系浮橋以渡，風迅水駛，橋不能成，乃禱於大孤山神，有頃，風息橋成，大軍畢渡。

translations.literal: Bayan reached Hukou and sent the commander of a thousand Ningyu to tie a floating bridge to cross; wind was swift and water rushed and the bridge could not be completed; he prayed to the god of Dagushan, and in a moment the wind ceased and the bridge was completed and the great army all crossed.
translations.idiomatic: At Hukou Bayan sent Commander Ningyu to build a floating bridge. Wind and current foiled it; he prayed at Dagushan, the wind dropped, the bridge held, and the army crossed.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅朔，伯顏至安慶，承制授文虎兩浙大都督，文虎以其從子友信知安慶府事，命萬戶喬珪戍之。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin of the second month Bayan reached Anqing and by imperial order made Wenhu Grand Commander of the Two Zhe circuits; Wenhu had his nephew Youxin know Anqing affairs and ordered the commander of ten thousand Qiao Gui to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On the second month's renyin Bayan reached Anqing and made Wenhu Grand Commander of Two Zhe; his nephew Youxin was left at Anqing and Commander Qiao Gui to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 丁未，次池州，都統制張林以城降；

translations.literal: On dingwei they halted at Chizhou; the overall commander Zhang Lin surrendered the city;
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei they reached Chizhou; Overall Commander Zhang Lin surrendered the city;

sentences.zh: 戊申，通判權州事趙昴發與其妻自經死，伯顏入城，見而憐之，令具衣衾葬焉。

translations.literal: on wushen the acting prefect Zhao Anguo and his wife hanged themselves; Bayan entered the city, saw it and pitied them, and ordered proper shrouds and burial.
translations.idiomatic: on wushen Acting Prefect Zhao Anguo and his wife hanged themselves. Bayan entered, pitied them, and ordered a proper burial.

sentences.zh: 宋宰臣賈似道遣宋京致書，請還已降州郡，約貢歲幣。

translations.literal: The Song chief minister Jia Sidao sent Song Jing with a letter asking return of already surrendered prefectures and offering annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chief Minister Jia Sidao sent Song Jing with a letter asking return of surrendered prefectures and offering annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 伯顏遣武略將軍囊加歹同其介阮思聰報命，止京以待，且使謂似道曰：「未渡江，議和入貢則可，今沿江諸郡皆內附，欲和，則當來面議也。」

translations.literal: Bayan sent the martial-strategy general Nangiyadai with his attendant Ruan Sicong to answer; he detained Jing to wait and also had them tell Sidao: "Before crossing the river, peace and tribute could be discussed; now along the river all prefectures have submitted—if you want peace, you must come in person to discuss."
translations.idiomatic: Bayan sent Martial Strategy General Nangiyadai with attendant Ruan Sicong to reply, detained Jing, and told Sidao, "Before we crossed, peace and tribute were possible; now the river prefectures have submitted—if you want peace, come discuss it in person."

sentences.zh: 囊加歹還，乃釋宋京。

translations.literal: When Nangiyadai returned, Song Jing was released.
translations.idiomatic: When Nangiyadai returned, Song Jing was released.

sentences.zh: 庚申，發池州，壬戌，次丁家洲。

translations.literal: On gengshen they set out from Chizhou; on renxu they halted at Dingjiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen they left Chizhou; on renxu they halted at Dingjiazhou.

sentences.zh: 賈似道都督諸路軍馬十三萬，號百萬，步軍指揮使孫虎臣為前鋒，淮西制置使夏貴以戰艦二千五百艘橫亙江中，似道將後軍。

translations.literal: Jia Sidao commanded all routes' armies, one hundred thirty thousand, called a million; the infantry commander Sun Huchen was vanguard; the Huai-Xi commissioner Xia Gui with two thousand five hundred warships lay across the river; Sidao held the rear army.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao commanded one hundred thirty thousand men—called a million—with Infantry Commander Sun Huchen in the van, Xia Gui and twenty-five hundred warships across the river, and Sidao in the rear.

sentences.zh: 伯顏命左右翼萬戶率騎兵夾江而進，砲聲震百里。

translations.literal: Bayan ordered the left and right wing commanders of ten thousand to lead cavalry along both banks; cannon thundered for a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan ordered left and right wing commanders to drive cavalry along both banks while cannon thundered for a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 宋軍陣動，貴先遁，以扁舟掠似道船，呼曰：「彼眾我寡，勢不支矣！」

translations.literal: The Song formation stirred; Gui fled first in a small boat, sweeping past Sidao's ship and crying: "They are many, we few—the force cannot hold!"
translations.idiomatic: The Song line wavered. Gui fled first in a skiff, sweeping past Sidao's ship crying, "They are too many—we cannot hold!"

sentences.zh: 似道聞之，倉皇失措，遽鳴金收軍，軍潰。

translations.literal: Sidao heard it, was frantic, hurriedly sounded gold to recall the army, and the army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Sidao panicked, hastily sounded recall, and the army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 眾軍大呼曰：「宋軍敗矣！」

translations.literal: The armies all shouted: "The Song army is defeated!"
translations.idiomatic: Troops shouted, "The Song is beaten!"

sentences.zh: 諸戰艦居後者，阿術促騎召之，挺身登舟，手柁沖敵船，舳艫相蕩，乍分乍合。

translations.literal: The warships in the rear—Aju urged his horse, summoned them, threw himself onto a boat, took the helm and charged enemy ships; the fleets clashed and parted and joined again.
translations.idiomatic: Aju spurred his horse, summoned the rear ships, boarded, took the helm, and rammed enemy vessels as fleets clashed, parted, and closed again.

sentences.zh: 阿術以小旗麾何瑋、李庭等並舟深入，伯顏命步騎左右掎之，追殺百五十餘里，溺死無算，得船二千餘艘，及其軍資器仗、圖籍符印。

translations.literal: Aju with a small flag directed He Wei, Li Ting, and others with linked boats to drive deep in; Bayan ordered foot and horse on both flanks; pursuit and slaughter ran one hundred fifty li; drowned were beyond count; more than two thousand boats were taken with military stores, maps, registers, seals, and tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Aju waved a small flag directing He Wei and Li Ting in linked boats deep into the line while Bayan's foot and horse flanked. Pursuit ran one hundred fifty li; countless drowned; two thousand boats and stores, maps, registers, and seals were taken.

sentences.zh: 似道東走揚州，貴走廬州，虎臣走泰州。

translations.literal: Sidao fled east to Yangzhou; Gui fled to Luzhou; Huchen fled to Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sidao fled east to Yangzhou; Gui to Luzhou; Huchen to Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，攻太平州。

translations.literal: On jiazi they attacked Taipingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi they attacked Taipingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，知州孟之縉及知無為軍劉權、知鎮巢軍曹旺、知和州王喜，俱以城降。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Taiping prefect Meng Zhijin and the Wuwei military commissioner Liu Quan, the Zhenchao military commissioner Cao Wang, and the Hezhou prefect Wang Xi all surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Taiping Prefect Meng Zhijin, Wuwei Commissioner Liu Quan, Zhenchao Commissioner Cao Wang, and Hezhou Prefect Wang Xi all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚午，師次建康之龍灣，大賚將士。

translations.literal: On gengwu the army halted at Longwan of Jiankang and greatly rewarded officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the army halted at Jiankang's Longwan and richly rewarded the troops.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，宋沿江制置趙溍遁，溍兄淮起兵溧陽，就執而死。

translations.literal: In the third month on guiyou the Song commissioner along the river Zhao Wen fled; Wen's brother Huai raised troops at Liyang and was seized and executed on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, Song River Commissioner Zhao Wen fled; his brother Huai raised troops at Liyang and was seized and executed.

sentences.zh: 都統徐王榮、翁福等以城降，命招討使唆都守之。

translations.literal: The overall commanders Xu Wangrong and Weng Fu and others surrendered the city; the pacification commissioner Sodu was ordered to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Overall Commanders Xu Wangrong and Weng Fu surrendered the city; Pacification Commissioner Sodu was left to guard it.

sentences.zh: 知鎮江府洪起畏遁，總管石祖忠以城降。

translations.literal: The Zhenjiang prefect Hong Qiwei fled; the supervisor Shi Zuzhong surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang Prefect Hong Qiwei fled; Supervisor Shi Zuzhong surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 知甯國府趙與可遁，知饒州唐震死，而江東諸郡皆下。

translations.literal: The Ningguo prefect Zhao Yuhe fled; the Raozhou prefect Tang Zhen died, and all the Jiangdong prefectures fell.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguo Prefect Zhao Yuhe fled; Raozhou Prefect Tang Zhen died; all Jiangdong prefectures fell.

sentences.zh: 淮西滁州諸郡亦相繼降。

translations.literal: The Huai-Xi prefectures of Chuzhou also surrendered in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-Xi prefectures including Chuzhou also surrendered in turn.

sentences.zh: 丙子，國信使廉希賢至建康，傳旨令諸將各守營壘，毋得妄有侵掠。

translations.literal: On bingzi the imperial envoy Lian Xixian reached Jiankang, transmitting an order that the generals each hold their camps and must not rashly plunder.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Imperial Envoy Lian Xixian reached Jiankang with orders that generals hold their camps and not plunder.

sentences.zh: 希賢與嚴忠範等奉命使宋，請兵自衛，伯顏曰：「行人以言不以兵，兵多，徒為累使事。」

translations.literal: Xixian with Yan Zhongfan and others were ordered to go to Song and requested troops for escort; Bayan said: "Envoys rely on words not soldiers—many soldiers only burden the mission."
translations.idiomatic: Xixian and Yan Zhongfan were sent to Song and asked for an escort. Bayan said, "Envoys travel on words, not soldiers—too many troops only burden the mission."

sentences.zh: 希賢固請，與之。

translations.literal: Xixian firmly requested and was given them.
translations.idiomatic: Xixian insisted and received them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至獨松嶺，果為宋人所殺。

translations.literal: On bingxu they reached Dusong Ridge and were indeed killed by Song men.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu they reached Dusong Ridge and were killed by Song men.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，伯顏遣左右司員外郎石天麟詣闕奏事，世祖大悅，悉可其奏。

translations.literal: On gengyin Bayan sent the Left and Right Secretariat Outer Office Member Shi Tianlin to court to report; the Shizu Emperor was greatly pleased and approved all his memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Bayan sent Outer Office Member Shi Tianlin to report; Kublai was greatly pleased and approved all memorials.

sentences.zh: 伯顏以行中書省駐建康，阿塔海、董文炳以行樞密院駐鎮江，阿術別奉詔攻揚州。

translations.literal: Bayan with the mobile Secretariat was stationed at Jiankang; Atahai and Dong Wenbing with the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs at Zhenjiang; Aju separately received an edict to attack Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan quartered the mobile Secretariat at Jiankang; Atahai and Dong Wenbing the mobile Bureau at Zhenjiang; Aju separately received orders to attack Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 江東歲饑，民大疫，伯顏隨賑救之，民賴以安。

translations.literal: Jiangdong had famine that year and the people suffered great pestilence; Bayan followed with relief and the people relied on him for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong suffered famine and plague that year; Bayan relieved them and the people were kept at peace.

sentences.zh: 宋人遣都統洪模移書徐王榮等，言殺使之事太皇太后及嗣君實不知，皆邊將之罪，當按誅之，願輸幣，請罷兵通好。

translations.literal: The Song sent the overall commander Hong Mo with a letter to Xu Wangrong and others, saying the Grand Empress Dowager and the heir did not truly know of killing the envoys—it was the fault of border generals who should be punished—and wished to offer tribute and cease troops for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent Overall Commander Hong Mo to Wangrong and others, claiming the Grand Empress Dowager and heir did not know of the envoy killings, blaming border generals, offering tribute and asking peace.

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰：「彼為譎詐之計，以視我之虛實。

translations.literal: Bayan said: "They use deceitful plans to spy on our strength and weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said, "This is deceit to probe our strength.

sentences.zh: 當擇人以同往，觀其事體，宣佈威德，令彼速降。」

translations.literal: We should choose men to go with them, observe how matters stand, proclaim majesty and virtue, and make them quickly surrender."
translations.idiomatic: Choose men to go with them, observe affairs, proclaim majesty, and make them surrender quickly."

sentences.zh: 乃命議事官張羽等持王榮答書，至平江驛，宋人又殺之。

translations.literal: He then ordered the deliberation officer Zhang Yu and others to carry Wangrong's reply to Pingjiang Station; the Song again killed them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Deliberation Officer Zhang Yu with Wangrong's reply to Pingjiang Station; the Song killed them again.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，有詔以時暑方熾，不利行師，俟秋再舉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on yichou there was an edict that with summer heat it was not favorable to march and they should wait until autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yichou, an edict said summer heat made campaigning unwise and they should wait for autumn.

sentences.zh: 伯顏奏曰：「宋人之據江海，如獸保險，今已扼其吭，少縱之則逸而逝矣。」

translations.literal: Bayan memorialized: "The Song hold rivers and seas like beasts guarding a defile—now we have seized their throat; if we slacken slightly they will escape."
translations.idiomatic: Bayan memorialized, "The Song cling to rivers and seas like beasts in a defile—we have their throat; slacken and they escape."

sentences.zh: 世祖語使者曰：「將在軍，不從中制，後法也。

translations.literal: The Shizu Emperor told the envoy: "The general in the army does not obey central command—that is later law. Follow the chancellor's words.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai told the envoy, "A general in the field does not take orders from the center—that is ancient law. Follow the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 宜從丞相言。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow the chancellor's words."
translations.idiomatic: Follow the chancellor's counsel."

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，復命奉御愛先傳旨，召伯顏赴闕，以阿剌罕為參政，留治省事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on dinghai he again ordered the palace attendant Aixian to transmit an order summoning Bayan to court, with Alahan as councillor left to manage Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dinghai, Palace Attendant Aixian was sent to summon Bayan to court, leaving Alahan as councillor to manage the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 伯顏至鎮江，會諸將計事，令各還鎮，乃渡江北行，入見於上都。

translations.literal: Bayan reached Zhenjiang, met the generals to plan, ordered each to return to his post, then crossed the river north and went in audience at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan reached Zhenjiang, met the generals, ordered each back to post, crossed north, and went to audience at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，進中書右丞相，讓功于阿術，遂以阿術為左丞相。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the seventh month he was promoted Right Chancellor of the Secretariat, yielded merit to Aju, and Aju was made Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month's guiwei he was promoted Right Chancellor, yielded merit to Aju, and Aju became Left Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，受命還行省，付以詔書，俾諭宋主。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the eighth month he received orders to return to the provincial commission, was given an edict, and instructed to announce it to the Song ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's guimao he was ordered back to the field commission with an edict to proclaim to the Song ruler.

sentences.zh: 乃取道益都，行視沂州等軍壘，調淮東都元帥孛魯歡、副都元帥阿裏伯，以所部兵沂淮而進。

translations.literal: He then went by Yidu, inspected the camps of Yizhou and other armies, and deployed the Huai-Dong Grand Marshal Berke and Vice Marshal Alibo with their troops to advance along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: He went by Yidu, inspected Yizhou camps, and sent Huai-Dong Grand Marshal Berke and Vice Marshal Alibo along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，會師淮安城下，遣新附官孫嗣武叩城大呼，又射書城中，諭守將使降，皆不應。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the ninth month the armies met below Huai'an city; he sent the newly submitted official Sun Siwu to shout at the walls and also shot letters into the city urging the defenders to surrender—all did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month's wuyin the armies met below Huai'an; newly submitted Sun Siwu shouted at the walls and letters were shot in—all refused.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，招討別吉裏迷失拒北城西門，伯顏與孛魯歡、阿裏伯親臨南城堡，揮諸將長驅而登，拔之，潰兵欲奔大城，追襲至城門，斬首數百級，遂平其南堡。

translations.literal: On gengchen the pacification commissioner Begleri blocked the north city west gate; Bayan with Berke and Alibo personally came to the south fort, waved the generals to charge and ascend, took it, routed troops wished to flee to the great city, pursuit reached the gate and several hundred heads were cut, and the south fort was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Pacification Commissioner Begleri held the north gate; Bayan with Berke and Alibo stormed the south fort, took it, pursued fugitives to the main gate, cut hundreds of heads, and pacified the south fort.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，次寶應軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu they halted at Baoying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu they halted at Baoying.

sentences.zh: 戊子，次高郵。

translations.literal: On wuzi they halted at Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi they reached Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 十月庚戌，圍揚州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on gengxu they besieged Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengxu, they besieged Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 召諸將指授方略，留孛魯歡、阿裏伯守灣頭新堡，眾軍南行。

translations.literal: He summoned the generals to assign plans, left Berke and Alibo to guard the new fort at Wantou, and the armies went south.
translations.idiomatic: He briefed the generals, left Berke and Alibo at Wantou's new fort, and marched south.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，至鎮江，罷行院，以阿塔海、董文炳同署事。

translations.literal: On renxu they reached Zhenjiang and abolished the mobile commission; Atahai and Dong Wenbing jointly managed affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu they reached Zhenjiang, abolished the mobile commission, and Atahai and Dong Wenbing jointly managed affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，伯顏分軍為三道，期會于臨安。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yihai Bayan divided the army into three routes to meet at Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yihai, Bayan divided the army in three columns to converge on Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 參政阿剌罕等為右軍，以步騎自建康出四安，趨獨松嶺；

translations.literal: The councillor Alahan and others were the right wing, with foot and horse out from Jiankang by Si'an toward Dusong Ridge;
translations.idiomatic: Councillor Alahan led the right wing by foot and horse from Jiankang through Si'an toward Dusong Ridge;

sentences.zh: 參政董文炳等為左軍，以舟師自江陰循海趨澉浦、華亭；

translations.literal: the councillor Dong Wenbing and others were the left wing, with the fleet from Jiangyin along the sea toward Ganpu and Huating;
translations.idiomatic: Councillor Dong Wenbing led the left by fleet from Jiangyin along the coast toward Ganpu and Huating;

sentences.zh: 伯顏及右丞阿塔海由中道，節制諸軍，水陸並進。

translations.literal: Bayan and the Right Chancellor Atahai took the center route, directing all armies, advancing together by land and water.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan and Right Chancellor Atahai took the center, commanding all forces by land and water.

sentences.zh: 壬午，伯顏軍至常州。

translations.literal: On renwu Bayan's army reached Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Bayan's army reached Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 先是，常州守王宗洙遁，通判王虎臣以城降，其都統制劉師勇與張彥、王安節等復拒之，推姚為守，固拒數月不下。

translations.literal: Earlier the Changzhou defender Wang Zongzhu had fled; the acting prefect Wang Huchen had surrendered the city, but the overall commander Liu Shiyong with Zhang Yan, Wang Anjie, and others again resisted, made Yao Su defender, and firmly held for several months without falling.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Defender Wang Zongzhu had fled and Acting Prefect Wang Huchen surrendered, but Overall Commander Liu Shiyong with Zhang Yan and Wang Anjie rebelled, made Yao Su defender, and held for months.

sentences.zh: 伯顏遣人至城下，射書城中招諭：勿以已降復叛為疑，勿以拒敵我師為懼。

translations.literal: Bayan sent men below the wall shooting letters into the city to summon and instruct: do not doubt because you had surrendered and rebelled again; do not fear because you resisted our army.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan shot letters into the city urging them not to fear for having surrendered once, nor for resisting now.

sentences.zh: 皆不應。

translations.literal: They all did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: They did not answer.

sentences.zh: 乃親督帳前軍臨南城，又多建火砲，張弓弩，晝夜攻之。

translations.literal: He then personally supervised the vanguard army at the south wall, built many fire cannon, drew crossbows, and attacked day and night.
translations.idiomatic: He personally led the vanguard at the south wall, raised many fire-lances and crossbows, and attacked day and night.

sentences.zh: 浙西制置文天祥遣尹玉、麻士龍來援，皆戰死。

translations.literal: The Huai-Xi commissioner Wen Tianxiang sent Yin Yu and Ma Shilong to aid them—both died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Huai-Xi Commissioner Wen Tianxiang sent Yin Yu and Ma Shilong to aid them; both died fighting.

sentences.zh: 甲申，伯顏叱帳前軍先登，豎赤旗城上，諸軍見而大呼曰：「丞相登矣。」

translations.literal: On jiashen Bayan shouted the vanguard to ascend first; they raised a red banner on the wall; the armies seeing it all shouted: "The chancellor has ascended."
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Bayan ordered the vanguard up first; a red banner rose on the wall and troops cried, "The chancellor is on the wall!"

sentences.zh: 師畢登。

translations.literal: The army all ascended.
translations.idiomatic: The whole force climbed up.

sentences.zh: 宋兵大潰，拔之，屠其城，姚及通判陳炤等死之，生獲王安節，斬之。

translations.literal: The Song army collapsed in great rout; it was taken and the city slaughtered; Yao Su and the acting prefect Chen Zhao and others died; Wang Anjie was captured alive and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: The Song force collapsed; the city was taken and sacked; Yao Su and Acting Prefect Chen Zhao died; Wang Anjie was captured and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 劉師勇變服單騎奔平江，諸將請追之，伯顏曰：「勿追，師勇所過，城守者膽落矣。」

translations.literal: Liu Shiyong changed clothes and fled alone on horseback to Pingjiang; the generals requested pursuit; Bayan said: "Do not pursue—wherever Shiyong passes, defenders' courage will fall."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiyong fled alone in disguise to Pingjiang. Generals asked to pursue; Bayan said, "Let him go—where he passes, garrisons will lose heart."

sentences.zh: 以行省都事馬恕為常州尹。

translations.literal: He made the Secretariat officer Ma Nu prefect of Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Secretariat Officer Ma Nu prefect of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 遣蒙古軍都元帥闍裏帖木兒、萬戶懷都先據無錫州，萬戶忙古歹、晏徹兒巡太湖，遣監戰亦乞裏歹、招討使唆都、宣撫使游顯，會闍裏帖木兒先趨平江。

translations.literal: He sent the Mongol army grand commander Yeltemür and the commander of ten thousand Huaiu first to seize Wuxi; the commanders of ten thousand Mangudai and Yanchir patrolled Tai Lake; he sent the battle overseer Yeqilidai, the pacification commissioner Sodu, and the commissioner You Xian to join Yeltemür and hurry first to Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Grand Commander Yeltemür and Commander Huaiu to Wuxi, Mangudai and Yanchir to patrol Tai Lake, and Overseer Yeqilidai, Sodu, and You Xian ahead to Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 先是，平江守潛說友遁，通判胡玉等既以城降，而復為宋人所據。

translations.literal: Earlier the Pingjiang defender Qian Yueyou had fled; the acting prefect Hu Yu and others had surrendered the city but Song men seized it again.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Defender Qian Yueyou had fled; Acting Prefect Hu Yu had surrendered, but Song forces seized the city again.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，眾軍次平江，都統王邦傑、通判王矩之率眾出降。

translations.literal: On jiachen the armies halted at Pingjiang; the overall commander Wang Bangjie and the acting prefect Wang Juzhi led the multitude out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the armies reached Pingjiang; Overall Commander Wang Bangjie and Acting Prefect Wang Juzhi led the people out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣囊加歹同其使柳岳還臨安。

translations.literal: On gengxu he sent Nangiyadai with their envoy Liu Yue back to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he sent Nangiyadai with envoy Liu Yue back to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 以忙古歹、範文虎行兩浙大都督事。

translations.literal: He made Mangudai and Fan Wenhu Grand Commanders of the Two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He made Mangudai and Fan Wenhu Grand Commanders of Two Zhe.

sentences.zh: 遣甯玉修吳江長橋，不旬日而成。

translations.literal: He sent Ningyu to repair the long bridge at Wujiang; in less than ten days it was done.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Ningyu to repair Wujiang's long bridge; it was finished in less than ten days.

sentences.zh: 庚申，囊加歹同宋尚書夏士林、侍郎呂師孟、宗正少卿陸秀夫以書來，請尊世祖為伯父，而世修子侄之禮，且約歲幣銀二十五萬兩，帛二十五萬匹。

translations.literal: On gengshen Nangiyadai with the Song Secretariat Member Xia Shilin, Vice Minister Lü Shimeng, and Court Ritualist Lu Xiufu came with a letter asking to honor the Shizu Emperor as uncle and observe the ritual of nephew to the imperial house, and also offering yearly tribute of two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver and two hundred fifty thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Nangiyadai returned with Song Secretariat Member Xia Shilin, Vice Minister Lü Shimeng, and Court Ritualist Lu Xiufu offering to honor Kublai as uncle with nephew's rites and yearly tribute of two hundred fifty thousand taels silver and bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣囊加歹同師孟等還臨安。

translations.literal: On guihai he sent Nangiyadai with Shimeng and others back to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he sent Nangiyadai back with Shimeng and others.

sentences.zh: 遣忙古歹、範文虎會阿剌罕、昔裏伯取湖州，知州趙良淳死之。

translations.literal: He sent Mangudai and Fan Wenhu to join Alahan and Shirbai to take Huzhou; the prefect Zhao Liangchun died.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Mangudai and Fan Wenhu with Alahan and Shirbai to take Huzhou; Prefect Zhao Liangchun died defending it.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，趙與可以城降。

translations.literal: On bingyin Zhao Yuhe surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhao Yuhe surrendered his city.

sentences.zh: 伯顏發平江，留遊顯、懷都、忽都不花屯兵鎮守。

translations.literal: Bayan set out from Pingjiang, leaving You Xian, Huaiu, and Qutubuqha with troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan left Pingjiang, leaving You Xian, Huaiu, and Qutubuqha to garrison.

sentences.zh: 別遣寧玉守長橋。

translations.literal: He separately sent Ningyu to guard the long bridge.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Ningyu separately to guard the long bridge.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月己巳，次嘉興，安撫劉漢傑以城降，留萬戶忽都虎等戍之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, first month jisi, he halted at Jiaxing; the commissioner Liu Hanjie surrendered the city; the commander of ten thousand Qutuqhu and others were left to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirteen, first month jisi, he reached Jiaxing; Commissioner Liu Hanjie surrendered; Commander Qutuqhu was left to garrison.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宋軍器監劉庭瑞以其宰臣陳宜中等書來，即遣回。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Song Arms Supervisor Liu Tingrui came with a letter from his chief minister Chen Yizhong and it was immediately sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Song Arms Supervisor Liu Tingrui brought a letter from Chief Minister Chen Yizhong; it was sent back at once.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宜中遣御史劉岊奉宋主稱臣表文副本，及致書伯顏，約會長安鎮。

translations.literal: On yihai Yizhong sent the censor Liu Bi with a copy of the Song ruler's subjection memorial and a letter to Bayan, appointing to meet at Chang'an Town.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Yizhong sent Censor Liu Bi with a copy of the subjection memorial and a letter to Bayan appointing meeting at Chang'an Town.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，眾軍至崇德。

translations.literal: On xinsi the armies reached Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the armies reached Chongde.

sentences.zh: 宜中又令都統洪模，持書同囊加歹來見。

translations.literal: Yizhong again ordered the overall commander Hong Mo to come with a letter together with Nangiyadai to meet.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong again sent Overall Commander Hong Mo with a letter to meet with Nangiyadai.

sentences.zh: 壬午，次長安鎮，宜中等不至。

translations.literal: On renwu they halted at Chang'an Town; Yizhong and the others did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu they halted at Chang'an Town; Yizhong and the others did not appear.

sentences.zh: 癸未，進軍臨平鎮。

translations.literal: On guimao the army advanced to Linping Town.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the army advanced to Linping.

sentences.zh: 甲申，次阜亭山，宋主遣知臨安府賈余慶，同宗室保康軍承宣使尹甫、和州防禦使吉甫，奉傳國璽及降表詣軍前。

translations.literal: On jiashen they halted at Futing Mountain; the Song ruler sent the Lin'an prefect Jia Yuqing with the clansman Baokang Army Commissioner Yin Fu and Hezhou Defender Ji Fu, bearing the imperial seal and surrender memorial to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen they halted at Futing Mountain. The Song emperor sent Lin'an Prefect Jia Yuqing with Commissioner Yin Fu and Defender Ji Fu bearing the imperial seal and surrender memorial to the camp.

sentences.zh: 伯顏受訖，遣囊加歹以余慶等還臨安，召宋宰臣出議降事。

translations.literal: Bayan received them and sent Nangiyadai with Yuqing and others back to Lin'an to summon the Song chief ministers to discuss surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan received them and sent Nangiyadai with Yuqing back to Lin'an to summon Song ministers to discuss surrender.

sentences.zh: 時宜中已遁，以文天祥代為丞相，不拜，自請至軍前。

translations.literal: At that time Yizhong had already fled; Wen Tianxiang replaced him as chief minister, would not bow, and asked to come to the army front himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong had already fled; Wen Tianxiang replaced him as chief minister, refused to bow, and asked to come to camp himself.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，進軍至臨安北十五里，分遣董文炳、呂文煥、範文虎巡視城堡，安諭軍民。

translations.literal: On yiyou the army advanced to fifteen li north of Lin'an; he separately sent Dong Wenbing, Lü Wenhuan, and Fan Wenhu to inspect the castles and pacify soldiers and people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the army advanced to fifteen li north of Lin'an; Bayan sent Dong Wenbing, Lü Wenhuan, and Fan Wenhu to inspect defenses and pacify the people.

sentences.zh: 囊加歹、洪模來報，宜中與張世傑、蘇劉義、劉師勇等，挾益王、廣王下浙江，航海而南，惟謝太后及幼主在宮中。

translations.literal: Nangiyadai and Hong Mo came to report that Yizhong with Zhang Shijie, Su Yiyu, Liu Shiyong, and others had taken the Prince of Yi and Prince of Guang down Zhejiang and fled south by sea; only Empress Dowager Xie and the young ruler remained in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Nangiyadai and Hong Mo reported that Yizhong with Zhang Shijie, Su Yiyu, and Liu Shiyong had fled south by sea with the princes; only Empress Dowager Xie and the young emperor remained.

sentences.zh: 伯顏亟遣使諭右軍阿剌罕、奧魯赤，左軍董文炳、範文虎，據守浙江，以勁兵五千人追之，不及而還。

translations.literal: Bayan urgently sent envoys to instruct the right wing Alahan and Oljei and the left wing Dong Wenbing and Fan Wenhu to hold Zhejiang and sent five thousand elite troops in pursuit—they did not overtake them and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan urgently ordered Alahan and Oljei on the right and Dong Wenbing and Fan Wenhu on the left to hold Zhejiang and sent five thousand elite troops in pursuit; they failed to overtake them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禁軍士毋入城，遣呂文煥持黃榜諭臨安中外軍民，俾安堵如故。

translations.literal: On bingxu he forbade soldiers to enter the city and sent Lü Wenhuan with a yellow placard to instruct Lin'an's soldiers and people within and without to dwell in peace as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he forbade troops to enter the city and sent Lü Wenhuan with a yellow placard assuring Lin'an's people they might dwell in peace.

sentences.zh: 先是，三衙衛士，白晝殺人，閭里小民，乘亂剽掠，至是民皆安之。

translations.literal: Earlier the Three Yamen guards killed by day; common people in the lanes plundered in the disorder—now the people were all at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the palace guards had killed by daylight and townsfolk had looted; now the people were at peace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，遣程鵬飛、洪雙壽等入宮，慰諭謝後。

translations.literal: On dinghai he sent Cheng Pengfei, Hong Shuangshou, and others into the palace to comfort Empress Dowager Xie.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he sent Cheng Pengfei and Hong Shuangshou into the palace to comfort Empress Dowager Xie.

sentences.zh: 戊子，謝後遣丞相吳堅、文天祥，樞密謝堂，安撫賈余慶，內官鄧惟善來見，伯顏慰遣之，顧天祥舉動不常，疑有異志，留之軍中。

translations.literal: On wuzi the empress dowager sent Chief Minister Wu Jian, Wen Tianxiang, Secretariat Chief Xie Tang, Commissioner Jia Yuqing, and the inner attendant Deng Weishan to meet; Bayan comforted and sent them back, but seeing Tianxiang's manner was unusual, suspected ulterior intent and detained him in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the empress dowager sent Wu Jian, Wen Tianxiang, Xie Tang, Jia Yuqing, and attendant Deng Weishan to meet. Bayan comforted them but, seeing Tianxiang's manner, detained him in camp.

sentences.zh: 天祥數請歸，伯顏笑而不答。

translations.literal: Tianxiang repeatedly asked to return; Bayan smiled and did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang repeatedly asked to return; Bayan smiled and did not answer.

sentences.zh: 天祥怒曰：「我此來為兩國大事，彼皆遣歸，何故留我？」

translations.literal: Tianxiang angrily said: "I came for the great affairs of two states—they all were sent back; why detain me?"
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang said angrily, "I came for the great affairs of two realms—why are others sent back while I am kept?"

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰：「勿怒。

translations.literal: Bayan said: "Do not be angry.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said, "Do not be angry.

sentences.zh: 汝為宋大臣，責任非輕，今日之事，政當與我共之。」

translations.literal: You are a great minister of Song; your responsibility is not light—today's affair should be shared with me."
translations.idiomatic: You are a great Song minister with heavy responsibility—today's business should be settled with me."

sentences.zh: 令忙古歹、唆都館伴羈縻之。

translations.literal: He ordered Mangudai and Sodu to lodge and restrain him.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Mangudai and Sodu to lodge and restrain him.

sentences.zh: 令程鵬飛、洪雙壽同賈余慶易宋主削帝號降表。

translations.literal: He ordered Cheng Pengfei and Hong Shuangshou with Jia Yuqing to exchange the Song ruler's memorial removing the imperial title for the surrender memorial.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Cheng Pengfei and Hong Shuangshou with Jia Yuqing to exchange the Song emperor's memorial removing the imperial title for the surrender form.

sentences.zh: 己丑，駐軍臨安城北之湖州市。

translations.literal: On jichou the army was stationed at Huzhou city north of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the army encamped at Huzhou north of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 遣千戶囊加歹等以宋傳國璽入獻。

translations.literal: He sent the commander of a thousand Nangiyadai and others to enter court presenting the Song imperial seal.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Commander Nangiyadai and others to court with the Song imperial seal.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，伯顏建大將旗鼓，率左右翼萬戶，巡臨安城，觀潮於浙江。

translations.literal: On gengyin Bayan raised the great general's drums and banners and led the left and right wing commanders of ten thousand to tour Lin'an city and view the tide on the Zhe River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Bayan raised the great general's drums and banners, led the wing commanders to tour Lin'an, and watched the tide on the Zhe River.

sentences.zh: 暮還湖州市，宋宗室大臣皆來見。

translations.literal: At evening he returned to Huzhou; Song imperial clan great ministers all came to meet.
translations.idiomatic: At evening he returned to Huzhou; Song imperial clan ministers came to meet.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，萬戶張弘范、郎中孟祺同程鵬飛，以所易降表及宋主、謝後諭未附州郡手詔至軍前。

translations.literal: On xinmao the commander of ten thousand Zhang Hongfan and the secretary Meng Qi with Cheng Pengfei brought the exchanged surrender memorial and the Song ruler's and Empress Dowager Xie's hand edicts to un-submitted prefectures to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhang Hongfan and Secretary Meng Qi with Cheng Pengfei brought the exchanged surrender memorial and hand edicts of the Song ruler and Empress Dowager Xie to the camp.

sentences.zh: 令鎮撫唐古歹罷文天祥所招募義兵二萬餘人。

translations.literal: He ordered the pacification commissioner Tangudai to disband the more than twenty thousand volunteer troops Wen Tianxiang had recruited.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Pacification Commissioner Tangudai to disband more than twenty thousand volunteers Wen Tianxiang had raised.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，伯顏登獅子峰，觀臨安形勢。

translations.literal: On renchen Bayan ascended Lion Peak to view Lin'an's terrain.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Bayan climbed Lion Peak to survey Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 命唆都撫諭軍民，部分諸將，共守其城，護其宮。

translations.literal: He ordered Sodu to pacify soldiers and people, assigned the generals each to guard the city and protect the palace.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Sodu to pacify the people, assigned generals to guard the city and protect the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，謝後復使人來勞問，仍以溫言慰遣之。

translations.literal: On guisi the empress dowager again sent men with courteous inquiries and was again comforted and sent back with gentle words.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the empress dowager sent courteous inquiries again and was again comforted and dismissed with gentle words.

sentences.zh: 甲午，分置其三衙諸司兵於各翼，以俟調遣；

translations.literal: On jiawu he placed the Three Yamen guards and various office troops in the various wings to await assignment;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he placed Three Yamen guards and office troops in the wings to await orders;

sentences.zh: 其生募等軍，願歸者聽。

translations.literal: those of the recruited armies who wished to return were permitted.
translations.idiomatic: recruited troops who wished to go home were permitted.

sentences.zh: 分遣蕭郁、王世英等，招諭衢、信諸州。

translations.literal: He separately sent Xiao Yu, Wang Shiying, and others to summon the Qu and Xin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Xiao Yu and Wang Shiying to summon Qu and Xin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，遣劉頡等往淮西招夏貴，仍遣別將徇地浙東、西，於是知嚴州方回、知婺州劉怡、知台州楊必大、知處州梁椅，並以城降。

translations.literal: In the second month on dingyou he sent Liu Yan and others to Huai-Xi to summon Xia Gui, and separately sent other commanders to overrun Zhe east and west; thus the Yanzhou prefect Fang Hui, Wuzhou prefect Liu Yi, Taizhou prefect Yang Bida, and Chuzhou prefect Liang Yi all surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou, he sent Liu Yan to summon Xia Gui and other columns through east and west Zhe; Yanzhou's Fang Hui, Wuzhou's Liu Yi, Taizhou's Yang Bida, and Chuzhou's Liang Yi surrendered.

sentences.zh: 命右丞張惠，參政阿剌罕、董文炳、呂文煥入見謝後，宣佈德意，以慰諭之。

translations.literal: He ordered the Right Chancellor Zhang Hui and the councillors Alahan, Dong Wenbing, and Lü Wenhuan to enter and meet the empress dowager, proclaiming virtue to comfort her.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Right Chancellor Zhang Hui and councillors Alahan, Dong Wenbing, and Lü Wenhuan to meet the empress dowager and proclaim the court's virtue.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宋主率文武百僚，望闕拜發降表。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Song ruler led the civil and military hundred officials to bow toward the palace gate and send the surrender memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Song emperor led civil and military officials to bow toward the palace gate and present the surrender memorial.

sentences.zh: 伯顏承制，以臨安為兩浙大都督府，忙古歹、範文虎入治府事。

translations.literal: Bayan by imperial order made Lin'an the Grand Commandery of the Two Zhe circuits; Mangudai and Fan Wenhu entered to manage the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order Bayan made Lin'an the Grand Commandery of Two Zhe; Mangudai and Fan Wenhu entered to govern.

sentences.zh: 復命張惠、阿剌罕、董文炳、呂文煥等入城，籍其軍民錢谷之數，閱實倉庫，收百官誥命、符印圖籍，悉罷宋官府。

translations.literal: He again ordered Zhang Hui, Alahan, Dong Wenbing, Lü Wenhuan, and others to enter the city, register the numbers of soldiers, people, money and grain, verify warehouses, collect officials' patents, tallies, registers, and maps, and abolish all Song offices.
translations.idiomatic: He again sent Zhang Hui, Alahan, Dong Wenbing, and Lü Wenhuan into the city to register troops, people, and stores, verify warehouses, collect patents and registers, and abolish Song offices.

sentences.zh: 取宋主居之別室。

translations.literal: The Song ruler was placed in a separate chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The Song emperor was lodged in a separate chamber.

sentences.zh: 分遣新附官招諭湖南北、兩廣、四川未下州郡。

translations.literal: He separately sent newly submitted officials to summon un-submitted prefectures of Hunan, Hubei, the two Guang, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He sent newly submitted officials to summon remaining prefectures in Hunan, Hubei, the two Guang, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 部分諸將，分屯要害，仍禁人不得侵壞宋氏山陵。

translations.literal: He assigned the generals to garrison key points and still forbade anyone from harming the Song imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: He posted generals at key points and forbade harm to Song imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 是日，進軍浙江之滸，潮不至者三日，人以為天助。

translations.literal: That day the army advanced to the Hu shore on the Zhe; for three days the tide did not come—people said Heaven helped.
translations.idiomatic: That day the army marched to the Zhe shore; for three days the tide did not rise—men called it Heaven's aid.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，謝後命吳堅、賈余慶、謝堂、家鉉翁、劉岊與文天祥並為祈請使，楊應奎、趙若秀為奉表押璽官，赴闕請命。

translations.literal: On guimao the empress dowager ordered Wu Jian, Jia Yuqing, Xie Tang, Jia Qianweng, Liu Bi, and Wen Tianxiang together as envoys praying for orders, with Yang Yingkui and Zhao Ruoxiu as memorial and seal bearers, to go to court to request commands.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the empress dowager named Wu Jian, Jia Yuqing, Xie Tang, Jia Qianweng, Liu Bi, and Wen Tianxiang envoys praying for orders, with Yang Yingkui and Zhao Ruoxiu bearing the memorial and seal to court.

sentences.zh: 伯顏拜表稱賀曰：

translations.literal: Bayan memorialized congratulation:
translations.idiomatic: Bayan memorialized in congratulation:

sentences.zh: 臣伯顏言：國家之業大一統，海嶽必明主之歸；

translations.literal: Your subject Bayan states: the state's enterprise is great unity; seas and mountains must return to a bright lord;
translations.idiomatic: Your subject Bayan states: the state's enterprise is great unity; seas and mountains must return to a bright lord;

sentences.zh: 帝王之兵出萬全，蠻夷敢天威之抗。

translations.literal: the emperor's army goes forth in perfect safety; barbarians dare resist Heaven's majesty.
