translations.idiomatic: the emperor's army advances in perfect safety; barbarians dare resist Heaven's majesty.

sentences.zh: 始干戈之爰及，迄文軌之會同。

translations.literal: From the beginning when arms were taken up, until writing and chariots were united.
translations.idiomatic: From the first taking up of arms until writing and chariot tracks were united,

sentences.zh: 區宇一清，普天均慶。

translations.literal: The realm is cleared; all under Heaven equally rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: the realm was cleared and all under Heaven rejoiced alike.

sentences.zh: 臣伯顏等誠歡誠忭，頓首頓首，恭惟皇帝陛下，道光五葉，統接千齡。

translations.literal: Your subjects Bayan and others are truly joyful, truly fearful, bowing head and bowing head, respectfully regarding Your Majesty the Emperor, whose Way shines through five generations and succession joins a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects Bayan and others rejoice and tremble, bowing again and again before Your Majesty, whose Way shines through five generations and whose succession joins a thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 梯航日出之邦，冠帶月支之域；

translations.literal: Ladder-ships and the lands of the rising sun, cap-and-girdle realms of the moon branch;
translations.idiomatic: Ladder-ships from lands of the rising sun and cap-and-girdle realms of the moon's branch;

sentences.zh: 際丹崖而述職，奄瀚海而為家。

translations.literal: at the red cliffs they present duty; the vast sea becomes home.
translations.idiomatic: at the red cliffs they presented duty until the vast sea became home.

sentences.zh: 獨此島夷，弗遵聲教，謂江湖可以保逆命，舟楫可以敵王師。

translations.literal: Only this island barbarians did not follow the transforming teaching, saying rivers and lakes could preserve rebellion and boats could oppose the royal army.
translations.idiomatic: Only this island people would not follow the transforming teaching, saying rivers and lakes could preserve rebellion and boats could oppose the royal army.

sentences.zh: 連兵負固，逾四十年，背德食言，難一二計。

translations.literal: They joined arms and relied on strength for more than forty years, repeatedly breaking faith and devouring words beyond one or two counts.
translations.idiomatic: They bore arms and relied on strength for more than forty years, repeatedly breaking faith beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 當聖主飛渡江南之日，遣行人乞為城下之盟。

translations.literal: When the sage lord flew across the south of the Yangtze, they sent envoys begging for peace beneath the walls.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage lord crossed the Yangtze they sent envoys begging peace beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 逮凱奏之言旋，輒詐謀之復肆。

translations.literal: When the victory report soon returned, they again plotted deceit.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported they again plotted deceit.

sentences.zh: 拘囚我信使，忘乾坤再造之恩；

translations.literal: They imprisoned our envoys, forgetting the grace of Heaven and Earth's renewal;
translations.idiomatic: They imprisoned our envoys, forgetting grace at Heaven and Earth's renewal;

sentences.zh: 招納我叛臣，盜漣海三城之地。

translations.literal: they harbored our defecting ministers, stealing the three cities of Lianhai.
translations.idiomatic: they harbored our defectors and stole the three cities of Lianhai.

sentences.zh: 我是以有六載襄樊之討，彼居然無一介行李之來。

translations.literal: Therefore we had the six-year campaign of Xiang and Fan; they still sent not a single bag of luggage.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore came the six-year campaign of Xiang and Fan; they still sent not a single bag of tribute.

sentences.zh: 禍既出於自求，怒致聞於斯赫。

translations.literal: Disaster came from their own seeking; wrath reached the news of this blaze.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster came from their own seeking; wrath blazed at the news.

sentences.zh: 臣伯顏等，肅將禁旅，恭行天誅。

translations.literal: Your subjects Bayan and others reverently lead the forbidden army and respectfully execute Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects Bayan and others reverently lead the forbidden army and execute Heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 爰從襄漢之上流，復出武昌之故渡。

translations.literal: Starting from the upper reaches of Xiang and Han, again issuing from Wuchang's old crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from the upper Xiang and Han, we again issued from Wuchang's old crossing.

sentences.zh: 籓屏一空于江表，烽煙直接於錢塘。

translations.literal: Screens and barriers were emptied south of the river; beacon fires reached straight to Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Screens south of the river were emptied; beacon fires reached Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 尚無度德量力之心，薦有殺使毀書之事。

translations.literal: Still they had no mind to measure virtue against strength, and again there was killing envoys and burning letters.
translations.idiomatic: Still they would not measure virtue against strength, and again killed envoys and burned letters.

sentences.zh: 屬廟謨之親廩，謂根本之宜先。

translations.literal: The temple plans personally stored grain, saying the root should come first.
translations.idiomatic: The temple plans stored grain in person, saying the root must come first.

sentences.zh: 乃命阿剌罕取道於獨松，董文炳進師於海渚，臣與阿塔海忝司中閫，直指偽都。

translations.literal: He ordered Alahan to take the route of Dusong; Dong Wenbing advanced troops from the sea shore; your subject with Atahai humbly managed the central command, pointing straight at the false capital.
translations.idiomatic: Alahan was ordered by Dusong; Dong Wenbing advanced from the sea; your subject with Atahai managed the center, pointing at the false capital.

sentences.zh: 掎角之勢既成，水陸之師並進。

translations.literal: The pincer position was formed; land and water armies advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: The pincer was formed; land and water advanced together.

sentences.zh: 常州已下，列郡傳檄而悉平；

translations.literal: Below Changzhou the commanderies all surrendered at proclamation;
translations.idiomatic: Below Changzhou commanderies surrendered at proclamation;

sentences.zh: 臨安為期，諸將連營而畢會。

translations.literal: Lin'an on schedule—all generals' camps finally met.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an on schedule—all generals' camps met at last.

sentences.zh: 彼知窮蹙，迭致哀鳴。

translations.literal: Knowing their extremity, they repeatedly sent pitiful cries.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing extremity, they sent pitiful cries again and again.

sentences.zh: 始則有為侄納幣之祈，次則有稱籓奉璽之請。

translations.literal: First there was the plea to be nephew and offer tribute; next the request to be vassal and present the seal.
translations.idiomatic: First they pleaded to be nephew and offer tribute; next to be vassal and present the seal.

sentences.zh: 顧甘言何益於實事，率銳卒直抵於近郊。

translations.literal: Sweet words were of no use to real affairs; sharp troops were led straight to the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet words availed nothing; sharp troops were led to the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 召來用事之大臣，放散思歸之衛士。

translations.literal: They summoned the great ministers in office and released guards who wished to return.
translations.idiomatic: They summoned ministers in office and released guards who wished to return.

sentences.zh: 崛強心在，四郊之橫草都無；

translations.literal: Stubborn hearts remained, yet on four sides the rank grass of resistance was gone;
translations.idiomatic: Stubborn hearts remained, yet on four sides no rank grass of resistance stood;

sentences.zh: 飛走計窮，一片之降幡始豎。

translations.literal: flying and running plans exhausted—a single sheet of surrender banner at last was raised.
translations.idiomatic: flight and running exhausted—a single sheet of surrender banner rose at last.

sentences.zh: 其宋國主已於二月初五日，望闕拜伏歸附訖。

translations.literal: The Song ruler on the fifth day of the second month had already bowed toward the palace gate and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Song emperor on the second month's fifth day had already bowed toward the palace gate and submitted.

sentences.zh: 所有倉廩府庫，封籍待命外，臣奉揚寬大，撫戢吏民，九衢之市肆不移，一代之繁華如故。

translations.literal: Apart from granaries and treasuries sealed awaiting orders, your subject broadly displayed leniency, pacifying officials and people; the markets of the nine streets did not shift, the splendor of a generation remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from granaries and treasuries sealed awaiting orders, your subject displayed leniency and pacified officials and people; the nine streets' markets did not shift and a generation's splendor remained.

sentences.zh: 茲惟睿算，卓冠前王，視萬里如目前，運天下於掌上。

translations.literal: Now only the sage calculation towers above former kings, seeing ten thousand li as before one's eyes, moving all under Heaven in the palm.
translations.idiomatic: Now only the sage calculation towers above former kings, seeing ten thousand li as before the eyes and moving the realm in the palm.

sentences.zh: 致令臣等，獲對明時，歌《七德》以告成，深切龍庭之想，上萬年而為壽，敬陳虎拜之詞。

translations.literal: Therefore your subjects obtained to face the bright age, singing the 'Seven Virtues' to report completion, deeply longing for the dragon court, offering ten thousand years of longevity, respectfully presenting the tiger bow of praise.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we obtained to face the bright age, singing the 'Seven Virtues' to report completion, longing for the dragon court, offering ten thousand years, respectfully presenting praise on bended knee.

sentences.zh: 臣伯顏等無任瞻天望聖激切屏營之至，謹奉表稱賀以聞。

translations.literal: Your subjects Bayan and others cannot bear gazing at Heaven and looking to the sage, urgently pressing in prostration, and respectfully present this memorial of congratulation to report.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects Bayan and others, gazing at Heaven and the sage with urgent joy, respectfully present this memorial of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 戊申，堅等發臨安，堂不行。

translations.literal: On wushen Jian and others set out from Lin'an; Tang would not go.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Jian and others left Lin'an; Xie Tang would not go.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，宋福王與芮奉書于伯顏，辭甚懇切，伯顏曰：「爾國既以歸降，南北共為一家，王勿疑，宜速來，同預大事。」

translations.literal: On guichou the Song Prince of Fu Ruirui presented a letter to Bayan, the words very earnest; Bayan said: "Your state has already submitted and north and south are one family—do not doubt, King; you should quickly come and share in the great affair."
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Song Prince of Fu Ruirui wrote earnestly to Bayan, who said, "Your realm has submitted and north and south are one family—do not doubt; come quickly and share in great affairs."

sentences.zh: 且遣迓之。

translations.literal: He also sent to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent men to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 戊午，夏貴以淮西降。

translations.literal: On wuwu Xia Gui submitted Huai-Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Xia Gui submitted Huai-Xi.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命囊加歹傳旨，召伯顏偕宋君臣入朝。

translations.literal: On gengshen he ordered Nangiyadai to transmit an order summoning Bayan with the Song ruler and ministers to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he ordered Nangiyadai to summon Bayan with the Song ruler and ministers to court.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，伯顏入臨安，俾郎中孟祺籍其禮樂祭器、冊寶、儀仗、圖書。

translations.literal: In the third month on dingmao Bayan entered Lin'an and had the secretary Meng Qi register ritual vessels, music instruments, registers, seals, regalia, maps, and books.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, Bayan entered Lin'an and had Secretary Meng Qi register ritual vessels, music, registers, seals, regalia, maps, and books.

sentences.zh: 庚午，囊加歹至。

translations.literal: On gengwu Nangiyadai arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Nangiyadai arrived.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，與芮來。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Ruirui came.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Ruirui came.

sentences.zh: 伯顏議以阿剌罕、董文炳留治行省事，以經略閩、粵；

translations.literal: Bayan deliberated leaving Alahan and Dong Wenbing to manage the mobile Secretariat and plan Min and Yue;
translations.idiomatic: Bayan planned to leave Alahan and Dong Wenbing to manage the mobile Secretariat and plan Fujian and Guangdong;

sentences.zh: 忙古歹以都督鎮浙西；

translations.literal: Mangudai as grand commander to garrison west Zhe;
translations.idiomatic: Mangudai as grand commander to garrison western Zhe;

sentences.zh: 唆都以宣撫使鎮浙東；

translations.literal: Sodu as commissioner to garrison east Zhe;
translations.idiomatic: Sodu as commissioner to garrison eastern Zhe;

sentences.zh: 唐兀歹、李庭護送宋君臣北上。

translations.literal: Tangudai and Li Ting to escort the Song ruler and ministers north.
translations.idiomatic: Tangudai and Li Ting to escort the Song court north.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，伯顏發臨安。

translations.literal: On yihai Bayan set out from Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Bayan left Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，阿塔海等宣詔，趣宋主、母后入覲，聽詔畢，即日俱出宮，惟謝後以疾獨留，隆國夫人黃氏、宮人從行者百餘人，福王與芮、沂王乃猷、謝堂、楊鎮而下，官屬從行者數千人，三學之士數百人。

translations.literal: On dingchou Atahai and others proclaimed the edict urging the Song ruler and empress dowager to attend court; when the edict was heard they all left the palace that day—only the empress dowager remained ill; the Dowager of Longguo Lady Huang, palace women, and more than a hundred followers; the Prince of Fu Ruirui, Prince of Yi Naiyou, Xie Tang, Yang Zhen, and below, officials and followers numbering thousands; scholars of the Three Academies numbering hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Atahai proclaimed the edict summoning the Song emperor and empress dowager to court; they left the palace that day—only the empress dowager remained ill; Lady Huang of Longguo, palace women, and more than a hundred followers; Prince Ruirui, Prince Naiyou, Xie Tang, Yang Zhen, thousands of officials, and hundreds of academy scholars went north.

sentences.zh: 宋主求見，伯顏曰：「未入朝，無相見之禮。」

translations.literal: The Song ruler asked to meet; Bayan said: "Before entering court there is no protocol for meeting."
translations.idiomatic: The Song emperor asked to meet; Bayan said, "Before entering court there is no protocol for meeting."

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，伯顏以宋主至上都，世祖禦大安閣受朝，降授宋主鳷開府儀同三司、檢校大司徒，封瀛國公。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on yiwei Bayan brought the Song ruler to Shangdu; the Shizu Emperor received audience in the Great Peace Pavilion, degraded and appointed the Song ruler as Commissioner with the Golden Seal, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Inspector-in-Chief Grand Marshal, enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei, Bayan brought the Song emperor to Shangdu; Kublai received audience in the Great Peace Pavilion, reduced him to Commissioner with the Golden Seal, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Inspector Grand Marshal, and enfeoffed him Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 宋平，得府三十七、州百二十八、關監二、縣七百三十三。

translations.literal: When Song was pacified there were obtained thirty-seven prefectures, one hundred twenty-eight districts, two passes and stations, and seven hundred thirty-three counties.
translations.idiomatic: With Song pacified there were thirty-seven prefectures, one hundred twenty-eight districts, two passes, and seven hundred thirty-three counties.

sentences.zh: 命伯顏告于天地宗廟，大赦天下。

translations.literal: He ordered Bayan to report to the temples of Heaven and Earth and the ancestral temple; a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was ordered to report to the temples of Heaven, Earth, and ancestors; a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 帝勞伯顏，伯顏再拜謝曰：「奉陛下成算，阿術效力，臣何功之有。」

translations.literal: The emperor comforted Bayan; Bayan bowed again and thanked him: "Following Your Majesty's completed plan, Aju exerted his strength—what merit have I?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor comforted Bayan; Bayan bowed and said, "Following Your Majesty's plan, Aju exerted strength—what merit have I?"

sentences.zh: 復拜同知樞密院，賜銀鼠青鼠只孫二十襲。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and given twenty robes of silver-mouse and blue-mouse zisun.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and given twenty robes of silver-mouse and blue-mouse zisun.

sentences.zh: 裨校有功者百二十三人，賞銀有差。

translations.literal: Deputy commanders with merit, one hundred twenty-three men, were rewarded with silver in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty-three meritorious deputy commanders received silver in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 初，海都稱兵內向，詔以右丞相安童佐皇子北平王那木罕，統諸軍于阿力麻裏備之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Haidu had called troops inward; an edict ordered the Right Chancellor Antong to assist the Prince of Beiping Nayan, commanding all armies at Alimali to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Haidu had raised troops inward; Antong was ordered to assist Prince of Beiping Nayan commanding armies at Alimali against him.

sentences.zh: 十四年，諸王昔裏吉劫北平王，拘安童，脅宗王以叛，命伯顏率師討之，與其眾遇于斡魯歡河，夾水而陣，相持終日，俟其懈，麾軍為兩隊，掩其不備，破之，昔裏吉走死。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the prince Shiregi seized the Prince of Beiping, detained Antong, and forced the clans to rebel; Bayan was ordered to lead troops to punish them; meeting their host at the Orqon River, they faced each other across the water a whole day; when they slackened he waved the army in two columns, took them unawares, broke them, and Shiregi fled and died.
translations.idiomatic: In year fourteen Prince Shiregi seized Beiping Prince, detained Antong, and forced clans to rebel; Bayan was ordered to punish them; at the Orqon they faced each other a day; when they slackened he split the army, surprised them, broke them, and Shiregi fled to his death.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，世祖命燕王撫軍北邊，以伯顏從，仍諭之曰：「伯顏才兼將相，忠於所事，故俾從汝，不可以常人遇之。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year the Shizu Emperor ordered the Prince of Yan to pacify the northern border with Bayan following, and again instructed him: "Bayan's talent combines general and minister; he is loyal to his charge—therefore he is sent with you; you must not treat him as an ordinary man."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year's second month Kublai ordered the Prince of Yan to pacify the north with Bayan following, saying, "Bayan combines general and minister and is loyal—do not treat him as an ordinary man."

sentences.zh: 燕王每與論事，尊禮有加。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yan whenever he discussed affairs treated him with added honor.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the Prince of Yan discussed affairs he honored Bayan especially.

sentences.zh: 是歲，頒群臣食邑，詔益以藤州等處四千九百七十七戶。

translations.literal: That year when enfeoffments were distributed to the ministers, an edict added Tengzhou and other places, four thousand nine hundred seventy-seven households.
translations.idiomatic: That year when enfeoffments were distributed, an edict added Tengzhou and other places totaling four thousand nine hundred seventy-seven households.

sentences.zh: 伯顏之取宋而還也，詔百官郊迎以勞之，平章阿合馬先百官半舍道謁，伯顏解所服玉鉤絛遺之，且曰：「宋寶玉固多，吾實無所取，勿以此為薄也。」

translations.literal: When Bayan returned from taking Song, an edict ordered all officials to go out of the suburbs to welcome and comfort him; the Grand Councillor Ahmad went out half a stage ahead of the officials to pay respects; Bayan untied the jade belt-hook he wore and gave it to him, saying: "Song had many jade treasures—I truly took none; do not take this as meager."
translations.idiomatic: When Bayan returned from conquering Song, officials were ordered to welcome him from the suburbs. Grand Councillor Ahmad met him half a stage ahead; Bayan gave him the jade belt-hook he wore, saying, "Song had many treasures—I took none; do not think this slight."

sentences.zh: 阿合馬謂其輕己，思中傷之，乃誣以平宋時取其玉桃盞，帝命按之，無驗，遂釋之，復其任。

translations.literal: Ahmad thought Bayan slighted him and plotted to harm him, falsely accusing that in pacifying Song he took a jade peach cup; the emperor ordered investigation—nothing was found—and he was released and restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Ahmad thought himself slighted and plotted harm, falsely accusing Bayan of taking a jade peach cup in pacifying Song; investigation found nothing and Bayan was restored.

sentences.zh: 阿合馬既死，有獻此盞者，帝愕然曰：「幾陷我忠良！」

translations.literal: After Ahmad died, someone presented this cup; the emperor said in astonishment: "I nearly harmed my loyal man!"
translations.idiomatic: After Ahmad died someone presented the cup; the emperor said in astonishment, "I nearly harmed a loyal man!"

sentences.zh: 別吉裏迷失嘗誣伯顏以死罪，未幾，以它罪誅，敕伯顏臨視，伯顏與之酒，愴然不顧而返。

translations.literal: Begleri had once falsely accused Bayan of a capital crime; before long he was executed for another crime; the emperor ordered Bayan to oversee the viewing; Bayan gave him wine, then turned away in grief and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Begleri had once accused Bayan of a capital crime; soon he was executed for another offense; the emperor ordered Bayan to witness it; Bayan gave him wine, then turned away grieving.

sentences.zh: 世祖問其故，對曰：「彼自有罪，以臣臨之，人將不知天誅之公也。」

translations.literal: The Shizu Emperor asked the reason; he replied: "He had his own crime—if your subject oversees it, people will not know Heaven's punishment is just."
translations.idiomatic: Kublai asked why; he replied, "He had his own crime—if I oversee it, people will not know Heaven's punishment is just."

sentences.zh: 二十二年秋，宗王阿只吉失律，詔伯顏代總其軍。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-second year the prince Ajigi lost discipline; an edict ordered Bayan to take overall command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year's autumn Prince Ajigi lost discipline; Bayan was ordered to take overall command of his army.

sentences.zh: 先是，邊兵嘗乏食，伯顏令軍中采蔑怯葉兒及蓿敦之根貯之，人四斛，草粒稱是，盛冬雨雪，人馬賴以不饑。

translations.literal: Earlier border troops had sometimes lacked food; Bayan ordered the army to gather mianqie leaves and mudu roots and store them—four hu per man, grass and grain by weight—and in deep winter snow the men and horses relied on this and did not hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier border troops had sometimes lacked food; Bayan ordered gathering mianqie leaves and mudu roots—four hu per man—and in deep winter snow men and horses did not hunger.

sentences.zh: 又令軍士有捕塔剌不歡之獸而食者，積其皮至萬，人莫知其意。

translations.literal: He also ordered soldiers who caught talabuqan beasts to eat them and pile the skins to ten thousand—no one knew his intent.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered soldiers who caught talabuqan beasts to eat them and pile skins to ten thousand—no one knew why.

sentences.zh: 既而遣使輦至京師，帝笑曰：「伯顏以邊地寒，軍士無衣，欲易吾繒帛耳。」

translations.literal: Later he sent envoys to transport them to the capital; the emperor laughed and said: "Bayan, because the border is cold and soldiers lack clothes, wished to trade our silks—that is all."
translations.idiomatic: Later he sent the skins to the capital; the emperor laughed, "Bayan, finding the border cold and troops without clothes, wished to trade for our silks—that is all."

sentences.zh: 遂賜以衣。

translations.literal: Clothes were then bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Clothes were then bestowed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春二月，或告乃顏反，詔伯顏窺覘之，乃多載衣裘入其境，輒以與驛人。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fourth spring someone reported Nayan's rebellion; an edict ordered Bayan to reconnoiter; he carried many fur coats into that territory and gave them to post-house men.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year's second spring someone reported Nayan's rebellion; Bayan was ordered to reconnoiter, carrying many fur coats and giving them to post-house men.

sentences.zh: 既至，乃顏為設宴，謀執之，伯顏覺，與其從者趨出，分三道逸去。

translations.literal: When he arrived Nayan set a feast and plotted to seize him; Bayan perceived it and with his followers rushed out, escaping in three separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived Nayan feasted him and plotted seizure; Bayan perceived it and fled with followers in three routes.

sentences.zh: 驛人以得衣裘故，爭獻健馬，遂得脫，馳還白狀。

translations.literal: Because the post-house men had received fur coats they vied to offer strong horses, and he escaped, galloping back to report.
translations.idiomatic: Post-house men, having received furs, vied to offer strong horses; he escaped and galloped back to report.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，乃顏反，從世祖親征。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Nayan rebelled; he followed the Shizu Emperor on the personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Nayan rebelled; Bayan followed Kublai on the personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 奏李庭、董士選將漢軍，得以漢法戰。

translations.literal: He memorialized Li Ting and Dong Shixuan to command Han troops so they could fight by Han methods.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized Li Ting and Dong Shixuan to command Han troops to fight by Han methods.

sentences.zh: 乃顏之党金家奴、塔不歹進逼乘輿，漢軍力戰，乃皆潰，卒擒乃顏。

translations.literal: Nayan's party Jinjianu and Tabudai pressed close to the imperial carriage; Han troops fought fiercely and all collapsed; Nayan was finally captured.
translations.idiomatic: Nayan's party Jinjianu and Tabudai pressed the imperial carriage; Han troops fought fiercely, all collapsed, and Nayan was captured.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，進金紫光祿大夫、知樞密院事，出鎮和林，和林置知院，自伯顏始。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was promoted Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Bright Light, knew the Bureau of Military Affairs, and went out to garrison Qara-qorum; the office of director at Qara-qorum began with Bayan.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-six he was promoted Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Bright Light, directed the Bureau of Military Affairs, and garrisoned Qara-qorum—the director's post there began with Bayan.

sentences.zh: 二十九年秋，宗王明理鐵木兒挾海都以叛，詔伯顏討之，相值于阿撒忽禿嶺，矢下如雨，眾軍莫敢登，伯顏令之曰：「汝寒君衣之，汝饑君食之，政欲效力於此時爾。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-ninth year the prince Mingli Timur supported Haidu in rebellion; an edict ordered Bayan to punish him; they met at Asaqutul Ridge; arrows fell like rain and the armies dared not ascend; Bayan told them: "The ruler clothes you when cold and feeds you when hungry—he wants your effort now.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year's autumn Prince Mingli Timur backed Haidu; Bayan was ordered against him; at Asaqutul arrows fell like rain; Bayan told the troops, "The ruler clothes you when cold and feeds you when hungry—serve now.

sentences.zh: 於此不勉，將何以報！」

translations.literal: If you do not strive here, how will you repay!"
translations.idiomatic: If you do not strive here, how will you repay?"

sentences.zh: 麾諸軍進，後者斬，伯顏先登陷陣，諸軍望風爭奮，大破之。

translations.literal: He waved the armies forward; those behind were beheaded; Bayan ascended first and broke the line; the armies seeing the wind vied in valor and broke them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: He waved the armies forward—stragglers were beheaded—Bayan climbed first and broke the line; troops vied in valor and routed them.

sentences.zh: 明裏鐵木兒挺身走，命速哥、梯迷禿兒等追之。

translations.literal: Mingli Timur fled in person; he ordered Suge, Timur Tului, and others to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Mingli Timur fled; he ordered Suge and Timur Tului to pursue.

sentences.zh: 伯顏引軍夜還，至必失禿，卒遇伏兵，伯顏堅壁不動，黎明，遂引去。

translations.literal: Bayan led the army back by night; at Beshbaliq he suddenly met ambush; Bayan held the walls without moving; at dawn they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan led the army back by night; at Beshbaliq he met ambush, held firm without moving, and at dawn withdrew.

sentences.zh: 伯顏輕騎追至別竭兒，速哥、梯迷禿兒等兵亦至，乃夾擊之，斬首二千級，俘其餘眾以歸。

translations.literal: Bayan with light horse pursued to Biejie'er; Suge, Timur Tului, and the others' troops also arrived; they attacked from both sides, cut two thousand heads, and captured the rest of the multitude and returned.
translations.idiomatic: With light horse he pursued to Biejie'er; Suge and Timur Tului arrived; they attacked both sides, cut two thousand heads, captured the rest, and returned.

sentences.zh: 諸將言：古禮，兵勝必祃旗於所征之地。

translations.literal: The generals said: by ancient ritual, after victory one must offer captured flags in the conquered land.
translations.idiomatic: Generals said that by ancient ritual victory required offering captured flags in conquered land.

sentences.zh: 欲用囚虜為牲，伯顏不可，眾皆嘆服。

translations.literal: They wished to use captives as victims; Bayan would not permit it and all sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: They wished to use captives as victims; Bayan refused and all admired him.

sentences.zh: 軍中獲諜者，忻都欲殺之，伯顏不許，厚賜之，遣齎書諭明裏鐵木兒以禍福，明裏鐵木兒得書感泣，以眾來歸。

translations.literal: A spy was captured in the army; Xindu wished to kill him; Bayan did not permit it but richly rewarded him and sent him with a letter advising Mingli Timur of fortune and disaster; Mingli Timur received the letter and wept, and with his host came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: A spy was taken; Xindu wished to kill him; Bayan richly rewarded him and sent a letter on fortune and disaster; Mingli Timur wept and submitted with his host.

sentences.zh: 未幾，海都復犯邊，伯顏留拒之。

translations.literal: Before long Haidu again invaded the border; Bayan remained to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Haidu again invaded the border; Bayan remained to resist.

sentences.zh: 廷臣有譖伯顏久居北邊，與海都通好，仍保守，無尺寸之獲者，詔以御史大夫玉昔帖木兒代之，居伯顏于大同，以俟後命。

translations.literal: Court ministers slandered that Bayan long dwelt on the northern border, was on good terms with Haidu, and still conservatively had no gain of territory; an edict replaced him with the Censor-in-Chief Yusip Temür and stationed Bayan at Datong to await later orders.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers slandered that Bayan long on the northern border was friendly with Haidu and gained no territory; Censor-in-Chief Yusip Temür replaced him and Bayan was stationed at Datong awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 玉昔帖木兒未至三驛，會海都兵復至，伯顏遣人語玉昔帖木兒曰：「公姑止，待我翦此寇而來，未晚也。」

translations.literal: Yusip Temür had not reached the third post when Haidu's troops came again; Bayan sent men to tell Yusip Temür: "Sir, halt for now—wait until I cut down this bandit and come; it is not late."
translations.idiomatic: Yusip Temür had not reached the third post when Haidu came again; Bayan sent word, "Halt—let me cut down this bandit first; it is not late."

sentences.zh: 伯顏與海都兵交，且戰且卻，凡七日，諸將以為怯，憤曰：「果懼戰，何不授軍于大夫！」

translations.literal: Bayan fought Haidu's troops, retreating while fighting seven days; the generals thought him timid and angrily said: "If you truly fear battle, why not give the army to the censor!"
translations.idiomatic: Bayan fought Haidu seven days, retreating while fighting; generals thought him timid and said angrily, "If you fear battle, give the army to the censor!"

sentences.zh: 伯顏曰：「海都縣軍涉吾地，邀之則遁，誘其深入，一戰可擒也。

translations.literal: Bayan said: "Haidu leads troops across our land—if we intercept he flees; lure him deep and one battle can capture him.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan said, "Haidu crosses our land—intercept and he flees; lure him deep and one battle captures him.

sentences.zh: 諸軍必欲速戰，若失海都，誰任其咎？」

translations.literal: You generals insist on quick battle—if Haidu is lost, who bears the blame?"
translations.idiomatic: You insist on quick battle—if Haidu escapes, who bears blame?"

sentences.zh: 諸將曰：「請任之。」

translations.literal: The generals said: "We take responsibility."
translations.idiomatic: Generals said, "We take responsibility."

sentences.zh: 即還軍擊敗之，海都果脫去。

translations.literal: He then turned the army and defeated them; Haidu indeed escaped.
translations.idiomatic: He turned the army and defeated them; Haidu escaped.

sentences.zh: 乃召玉昔帖木兒至軍，授以印而行。

translations.literal: He then summoned Yusip Temür to the army, handed over the seal, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: He then summoned Yusip Temür, handed over the seal, and departed.

sentences.zh: 時成宗以皇孫奉詔撫軍北邊，舉酒以餞曰：「公去，將何以教我？」

translations.literal: At that time Chengzong as imperial grandson received an edict to pacify the northern army; raising a cup to send him off he said: "When you go, what will you teach me?"
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong as imperial grandson was ordered to pacify the northern army; raising a cup to send Bayan off he said, "When you go, what will you teach me?"

sentences.zh: 伯顏舉所酌酒曰：「可慎者，惟此與女色耳。

translations.literal: Bayan raised the wine he had poured and said: "What must be guarded is only this and women's beauty.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan raised his cup and said, "Guard only this and women's beauty.

sentences.zh: 軍中固當嚴紀律，而恩德不可偏廢。

translations.literal: In the army discipline must be strict, yet favor must not be wholly abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In camp discipline must be strict, yet favor must not be wholly abandoned.

sentences.zh: 冬夏營駐，循舊為便。」

translations.literal: Winter and summer encampments—following the old ways is convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Winter and summer camps—follow the old ways."

sentences.zh: 成宗悉從之。

translations.literal: Chengzong followed all of this.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong followed all of this.

sentences.zh: 三十年冬十二月，驛召至自大同，世祖不豫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the thirtieth winter he was summoned by post from Datong; the Shizu Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year's twelfth winter he was summoned by post from Datong; Kublai was unwell.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，世祖崩，伯顏總百官以聽。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year the Shizu Emperor died; Bayan directed all officials in government.
translations.idiomatic: In the next year's first month Kublai died; Bayan directed all officials in government.

sentences.zh: 兵馬司請日出鳴晨鐘，日入鳴昏鐘，以防變故，伯顏呵之曰：「汝將為賊邪！

translations.literal: The Horse and Arms Office requested sounding the morning bell at sunrise and the evening bell at sunset to guard against trouble; Bayan shouted at them: "Will you be rebels! Let it be as on ordinary days.
translations.idiomatic: The Horse and Arms Office asked to sound morning and evening bells against trouble; Bayan shouted, "Will you be rebels! Let it be as on ordinary days.

sentences.zh: 其一如平日。」

translations.literal: Let it be as on ordinary days."
translations.idiomatic: Let it be as on ordinary days."

sentences.zh: 適有盜內府銀者，宰執以其幸赦而盜，欲誅之，伯顏曰：「何時無盜，今以誰命而誅之？」

translations.literal: There happened to be a thief of silver from the inner treasury; the chief ministers, because an amnesty was expected, wished to execute him; Bayan said: "When are there no thieves—on whose authority now shall we execute?"
translations.idiomatic: A thief stole silver from the inner treasury; ministers, expecting amnesty, wished to execute him; Bayan said, "When are there no thieves—on whose authority execute now?"

sentences.zh: 人皆服其有識。

translations.literal: People all submitted that he had judgment.
translations.idiomatic: All admired his judgment.

sentences.zh: 成宗即位於上都之大安閣，親王有違言，伯顏握劍立殿陛，陳祖宗寶訓，宣揚顧命，述所以立成宗之意，辭色俱厲，諸王股栗，趨殿下拜。

translations.literal: Chengzong was enthroned at the Great Peace Pavilion of Shangdu; princes had dissenting words; Bayan grasped a sword and stood on the palace steps, stated the ancestral instructions, proclaimed the testamentary order, explained why Chengzong was established—words and color both stern—and the princes trembled, hurried below the steps and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was enthroned at Shangdu's Great Peace Pavilion; princes murmured; Bayan grasped a sword on the palace steps, stated ancestral instructions and the testament, explained Chengzong's establishment with stern words and color, and princes trembled and bowed below the steps.

sentences.zh: 五月，拜開府儀同三司、太傅、錄軍國重事，依前知樞密院事，賜金銀各有差。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was appointed Commissioner with the Golden Seal, Grand Preceptor, Recorder of Important State Affairs, as before directing the Bureau of Military Affairs, with gold and silver bestowed in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was appointed Commissioner with the Golden Seal, Grand Preceptor, Recorder of State Affairs, still directing the Bureau of Military Affairs, with gold and silver bestowed.

sentences.zh: 時相有忌之者，伯顏語之曰：「幸送我兩罌美酒，與諸王飲于宮前，餘非所知也。」

translations.literal: At that time a colleague envied him; Bayan said to him: "Fortune sends me two jars of fine wine to drink with the princes before the palace—beyond that I know nothing."
translations.idiomatic: A colleague envied him; Bayan said, "Fortune sends me two jars of fine wine for the princes before the palace—beyond that I know nothing."

sentences.zh: 江南三省累請罷行樞密院，成宗問于伯顏，時已屬疾，張目對曰：「內而省、院各置為宜，外而軍、民分隸不便。」

translations.literal: The three provinces of Jiangnan repeatedly asked to abolish the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs; Chengzong asked Bayan; he was already ill and opening his eyes replied: "Within, Secretariat and Bureau each established is fitting; without, separating army and people is inconvenient."
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's three provinces repeatedly asked to abolish the mobile Bureau; Chengzong asked Bayan, already ill, who opened his eyes and said, "Within, separate Secretariat and Bureau; without, splitting army and people is inconvenient."

sentences.zh: 成宗是之，三院遂罷。

translations.literal: Chengzong approved this and the three bureaus were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong approved and the three bureaus were abolished.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月丙申，有大星隕于東北。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingchen a great star fell in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, a great star fell in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On jihai rain froze on trees.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai rain froze on trees.

sentences.zh: 庚子，伯顏薨，年五十九。

translations.literal: On gengzi Bayan died, age fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Bayan died at fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 伯顏深略善斷，將二十萬眾伐宋，若將一人，諸帥仰之若神明。

translations.literal: Bayan was deep in strategy and good at decision; leading two hundred thousand to attack Song he was as if commanding one man—the various commanders looked up to him as to a spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was deep in strategy and decisive; commanding two hundred thousand against Song he moved them as one man—commanders looked to him as to a spirit.

sentences.zh: 畢事還朝，歸裝惟衣被而已，未嘗言功也。

translations.literal: When the affair was done and he returned to court, his baggage was only clothes and bedding; he never spoke of merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended his baggage was only clothes and bedding; he never spoke of merit.

sentences.zh: 大德八年，特贈宣忠佐命開濟功臣、太師、開府儀同三司，追封淮安王，諡忠武。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dade he was specially posthumously enfeoffed as Merit Minister Who Opens Loyalty and Aids the Mandate, Grand Preceptor, Commissioner with the Golden Seal, enfeoffed Prince of Huai'an, posthumous title Zhongwu.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade year eight he was posthumously enfeoffed Merit Minister Who Opens Loyalty and Aids the Mandate, Grand Preceptor, Commissioner with the Golden Seal, Prince of Huai'an, posthumous title Zhongwu.

sentences.zh: 至正四年，加贈宣忠佐命開濟翊戴功臣，進封淮王，餘如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhizheng he was further enfeoffed as Merit Minister Who Opens Loyalty, Aids the Mandate, and Supports the Throne, advanced to Prince of Huai, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhizheng year four he was further enfeoffed Merit Minister Who Opens Loyalty, Aids the Mandate, and Supports the Throne, advanced to Prince of Huai, the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 子買的，僉樞密院事；

translations.literal: His son Maidi was Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: His son Maidi was Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 囊加歹，樞密副使。

translations.literal: Nangiyadai, Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Nangiyadai was Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 孫相嘉失禮，同僉樞密院事、集賢學士。

translations.literal: His grandson Xiangjia Shili was Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Academician of the Hall of Gathered Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Xiangjia Shili was Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Academician of the Hall of Gathered Excellence.

sentences.zh: 至治末，省先塋于白只剌山，聞有變，赴上都，或勸少避之，曰：「我與國同休戚，今有難，可避乎！」

translations.literal: At the end of Zhizhi he visited the ancestral graves at Baizhila Mountain; hearing of trouble he hurried to Shangdu; some urged slight avoidance; he said: "I share weal and woe with the state—now there is difficulty—can I avoid it!"
translations.idiomatic: At Zhizhi's end he visited ancestral graves at Baizhila Mountain; hearing trouble he hurried to Shangdu; some urged avoidance; he said, "I share weal and woe with the state—can I avoid difficulty now?"

sentences.zh: 至上都，果見囚。

translations.literal: Reaching Shangdu he was indeed imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Shangdu he was indeed imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 久之得釋，尋拜河南江北行省平章政事，遷江南行台御史大夫。

translations.literal: After long he was released; soon he was appointed Grand Councillor of the Henan and Jiangbei mobile Secretariat, then transferred Grand Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After long imprisonment he was released, soon made Grand Councillor of the Henan-Jiangbei mobile Secretariat, then transferred Grand Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 曾孫普達失理，皆能世其家。

translations.literal: His great-grandson Puda Shili—all were able to inherit the family.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Puda Shili—all were able to carry on the family line.
